UnitStatement: The Desktop Physics Workflow Smoke check covers the TP-MAC-02 desktop path over invented local preview data.
The smoke check is intentionally limited to workflow wiring and product-boundary signals.
The smoke check is not a validation, certification, compliance, or professional approval check.
Start the desktop app with: npm run dev --workspace apps/desktop.
Open the Vite URL printed by the command, normally http://127.0.0.1:5173/.
Initial load shows data-testid="desktop-preview-shell" and the header "OpenPipeStress Technical Preview".
The solve-panel shows initial status values from the fixture, including status-mechanics with "ready for preview diagnostics".
Clicking run-mechanics-preview triggers the mechanics preview run.
Results render in results-panel with grouped sections: result-group-displacement, result-group-reaction, result-group-force, result-group-moment, and result-group-stress.
Results include result rows result:force:pipe-P-120:axial and result:force:pipe-P-120:axial:end-j.

Clicking the axial force row opens result-detail-panel showing axial_force, element_local, end_i, recovered_from_local_element_stiffness, the sign convention, pipe:P-120, DEL-14-02, and run:preview-linear-static-001.
The endpoint-pair-table shows both result:force:pipe-P-120:axial and result:force:pipe-P-120:axial:end-j.
Clicking the axial end-j force row opens a detail panel showing end_j and the j-end sign convention.
Results include result:stress:pipe-P-120 and result:stress:pipe-P-120:end-j:torsional-shear.

Clicking the end-j torsional-shear stress row opens result-detail-panel showing torsional_shear_stress, element_local, end_j, recovered_from_open_mechanics_stress_components, pipe:P-120, and the paired result:stress:pipe-P-120:end-i:torsional-shear.
The model context selects pipe:P-120 and the property inspector (aria-label="Property inspector") shows "Rack span".

Results include quarter-station and shear rows: result:force:pipe-P-120:shear-y, result:force:pipe-P-120:shear-y:end-j, result:force:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:shear-y, result:force:pipe-P-120:midspan:shear-z, result:force:pipe-P-120:quarter-3:shear-z, and result:moment:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:bending-z.
Clicking the midspan axial force row shows midspan, interpolated_from_endpoint_resultants, and no endpoint-pair table.
Clicking the quarter-1 shear-y force row shows shear_force_y, quarter_1, interpolated_from_endpoint_resultants, and no endpoint-pair table.
Clicking the shear-y force row confirms endpoint-pair display still applies to endpoint shear force rows and includes result:force:pipe-P-120:shear-y:end-j.

Results include result:combination:combination-C-OPER-ALT:force:pipe-P-120:axial; its detail panel shows explicit_user_linear_combination, combination:combination:C-OPER-ALT, source result refs for result:force:pipe-P-120:axial and result:loadcase:load-L-200:force:pipe-P-120:axial, and no compliance or professional approval claim.
Results include result:combination:combination-C-OPER-ALT:force:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:shear-y and result:stress:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:torsional-shear.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:endpoint-j-recovery with status implemented; this is not a compliance failure.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:endpoint-stress-components with status implemented; this is not a compliance failure.

The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:station-recovery with status implemented: fixed station-grid recovery implemented, with arbitrary station sweeps, exact internal diagrams, and shear stress recovery deferred.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:thermal-behavior with status implemented, with broader thermal combinations and temperature-dependent properties deferred.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:load-combinations with status implemented, with code/rule combinations still deferred.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:pressure-frame-load with status implemented, with broader pressure behavior still deferred.

Results include result:stress:pipe-P-120:end-i:pressure-hoop, exclude pressure-longitudinal and shear stress rows such as result:stress:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:shear-y, and diagnostics do not include PRESSURE_LOAD_NOT_APPLIED_TO_FRAME_VECTOR.
Diagnostics render diagnostics-panel and include diagnostic-HIGH_DISPLACEMENT_REVIEW and diagnostic-RULE_CHECK_INPUTS_MISSING.

Clicking diagnostic-HIGH_DISPLACEMENT_REVIEW shows diagnostic-detail-panel with diagnostic:physics:high-displacement-review, result:disp:node-N-140, node:N-140, linked result value context, and the review-only professional boundary.
The model context selects node:N-140 and the property inspector (aria-label="Property inspector") shows "Terminal tie-in".
Knowledge renders knowledge-panel and includes computed context for result:disp:node-N-140 and result:force:pipe-P-120:axial.

Report packet renders report-panel and report-packet-body with selected result refs including displacement, force, midspan, quarter, combination, and torsional-shear stress results for node-N-140 and pipe-P-120.
Report packet includes report-analysis-run with DEL-14-02 and run:preview-linear-static-001; report-packet-body includes the result-value hash and result_envelope audit context.
Report packet includes report-load-basis-refs with load:L-100, load:L-200, and combination:C-OPER-ALT.
Clicking generate-review-proposal generates a review proposal.
The proposal renders proposal-body and references the selected review target result:stress:pipe-P-120:end-j:torsional-shear if the endpoint stress row remains selected.
After selecting diagnostic-HIGH_DISPLACEMENT_REVIEW, generating a proposal references diagnostic:physics:high-displacement-review and uses diagnostic review wording.
accept-proposal-disabled is disabled; the proposal must remain review-only and must not mutate accepted model state.
Footer retains the technical-preview boundary text and does not claim production readiness, release readiness, certification, sealing, code compliance, or licensed engineering reliance.

apply_operation_json(model_json, intent_json, claimed_model_hash_json): string validates and, when no blocking finding exists, applies the single change to a cloned model document, returning the OperationOutcome document as a JSON string.

canonical_json_string(value_json): string canonicalizes a JSON document with the engine's canonical form — RFC 8785 (JCS) since completion-plan H5 — the same function the engine uses for model hashes; the desktop frontend has no canonicalization of its own (H1 / F-5a hash seam).
canonical_sha256_hex(value_json): string returns the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the canonical form of a JSON document (H1 / F-5a hash seam companion to canonical_json_string).
validate_operation_json(model_json, intent_json, claimed_model_hash_json): string validates a structured editor-operation intent and returns the OperationOutcome document as a JSON string.
The InitOutput interface exposes memory plus the wasm exports (apply/validate/canonical functions and wbindgen malloc/realloc/free/start) defining the engine's wasm ABI.
initSync(module) and the default __wbg_init(module_or_path) instantiate the wasm module synchronously or asynchronously, returning InitOutput.
The generated wasm-bindgen glue declares @ts-self-types pointing at the operation_applier .d.ts.
apply_operation_json glue passes model/intent/hash strings into wasm memory, calls wasm.apply_operation_json, returns the result string, and frees the deferred buffer in a finally block.
canonical_json_string glue marshals the value JSON into wasm, returns the canonical string, and throws a wasm-thrown error via takeFromExternrefTable0 when the error flag is set.
canonical_sha256_hex glue marshals the value JSON into wasm and returns the SHA-256 hex string, throwing on the wasm error flag.
validate_operation_json glue marshals model/intent/hash strings into wasm, calls wasm.validate_operation_json, and returns the outcome string.
__wbg_get_imports builds the wasm import object, wiring an Error constructor binding and __wbindgen_init_externref_table that seeds the externref table with undefined/null/true/false.
passStringToWasm0 encodes a JS string into wasm memory using the cached TextEncoder with malloc/realloc, handling the realloc-undefined fast path and multibyte growth.
decodeText decodes wasm memory bytes via a cached UTF-8 TextDecoder and resets the decoder once MAX_SAFARI_DECODE_BYTES (2146435072) is reached to avoid a Safari decode limit.
__wbg_finalize_init stores the instance/module, caches exports as wasm, resets the Uint8Array memory cache, and calls wasm.__wbindgen_start.

__wbg_load instantiates the module via WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming when given a Response, falling back to WebAssembly.instantiate with a warning when the server does not serve application/wasm MIME type.
initSync(module) returns the cached wasm if already initialized, otherwise builds imports, compiles a WebAssembly.Module if needed, and finalizes init.

__wbg_init(module_or_path) defaults module_or_path to open_pipe_stress_operation_applier_bg.wasm relative to import.meta.url, fetches URL/Request inputs, loads, and finalizes init; exported as the default.

The _bg.wasm.d.ts declares the raw wasm exports: memory plus apply_operation_json, canonical_json_string, canonical_sha256_hex, validate_operation_json, and the wbindgen malloc/realloc/free/externref/start primitives.

build-wasm-engine.mjs builds the wasm32 browser operation engine (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) by compiling core/model_operations/operation_applier with --features wasm, then binding with the pinned wasm-bindgen CLI into public/wasm-engine/.

Vite serves public/ at the site root in dev and copies it verbatim into dist, so the same root /wasm-engine/ URL works in dev, vite preview, and the packaged tauri:// asset protocol (TP-APP-R2-WASMPKG-001); the prior src/.../__generated__/ location was never emitted into dist.
Generated wasm glue is written to a temp directory and renamed into place so concurrent readers never see a half-written artifact set (DEC-025 F-4 rider); generated artifacts are not committed.
The build script pins PINNED_WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION = 0.2.123, which must match the crate's pinned wasm-bindgen dependency exactly.
The script resolves the operation_applier crate dir and expects the wasm artifact at target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/open_pipe_stress_operation_applier.wasm, writing glue to public/wasm-engine.
fail(lines) prints a formatted [build-wasm-engine] FAILED block and exits with code 1; every missing prerequisite fails with the exact remediation command and no silent fallback.
The build verifies cargo is on PATH, failing with rustup install guidance if absent.
The build verifies the wasm32-unknown-unknown target is installed via rustup, failing with 'rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown' guidance otherwise.
The build locates the wasm-bindgen CLI on PATH or in ~/.cargo/bin and fails with a cargo install command if missing.
The build asserts the wasm-bindgen CLI version equals the pinned crate version, failing because mismatched CLI/crate versions produce broken or subtly different glue.
The build compiles the engine via cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm --release and fails if the build errors or the expected artifact is missing.

The build generates web-target glue into a sibling temp dir then swaps it into place with renames (DEC-025 F-4 rider), removing stale .tmp-*/.old-* siblings and the legacy __generated__ location first.
The build runs wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir <tmp>, renames the existing out dir to .old, renames tmp into place, and removes the old dir to swap the whole directory atomically.

lib.rs declares the model_document_migration module for evaluating and recording model-document schema migrations.
lib.rs imports the library-import provenance crate (open_pipe_stress_library_import_document) as library_import_document.
lib.rs imports apply_operation and validate_operation from the open_pipe_stress_operation_applier crate.
lib.rs imports run_linear_static_preview and LinearStaticPreviewRequest from the open_pipe_stress_product_physics crate.
lib.rs imports the rule_check_runner crate for running rule-pack checks against solved models.
lib.rs imports the rule_pack_document crate for rule-pack validation and checksum computation.
lib.rs imports catalog_definitions and UnitDefinition from the open_pipe_stress_units crate.
lib.rs uses rusqlite (params, Connection, OptionalExtension) as the embedded SQLite storage engine.
PROJECT_STORE_FILE is the local project store filename 'openpipestress-projects.sqlite3'.
fixture_path resolves a product_preview fixture file across candidate relative paths and errors if none exists.
read_fixture loads a product_preview fixture path and parses it as JSON.
UnitCatalogResponse is the serialized unit-catalog response carrying schema_version, catalog_id, decision_basis, calculation_basis, storage_convention, entries, and a boundary.
UnitCatalogEntry serializes a single unit definition's id, symbol, dimension, canonical flag, transform_kind, factor/offset representations, provenance, and review_status.
UnitCatalogBoundary records that the unit catalog includes no protected content, no private project data, and claims no professional approval or code compliance.
unit_transform_kind returns 'identity' for a canonical unit, otherwise the schema value of the unit's transform_to_canonical kind.
unit_catalog_entry maps a UnitDefinition into a serializable UnitCatalogEntry.
desktop_unit_catalog builds the unit-catalog response from catalog_definitions with catalog_id 'unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display', decision_basis DEC-018, and calculation_basis si_canonical.
The unit catalog storage convention is 'entered_units_preserved' (units are stored as entered, not converted).
StorageCapability serializes the local storage capability: SQLite engine, bundled, fts5 availability, no network/daemon/telemetry, path and large-file policies, and migration evidence.
Local storage requires no network and no daemon, and has telemetry disabled.
LocalProjectSummary serializes a stored project's identity, storage mode, migration evidence, persisted-artifact counts and refs, and a unit round-trip status.
LocalProjectIndexEntry serializes a project index row: project_id, name, storage_mode, and created/updated unix timestamps.
LocalProjectEnvelope bundles a project summary with its model, editor_intents, proposal, selected_review_target, mechanics_result, analysis_run, hashes, and model-migration ledger.
SaveLocalProjectRequest is the deserialized save request; optional members default and model_document_migration carries open-time migration status for ledger recording (DEC-019).
SelectedReviewTarget deserializes a review target's target_type and id.
app_store_path returns the app-local data directory project store path, creating the directory if needed.
STORE_SCHEMA_TARGET_VERSION is 11 — the target SQLite store schema version.
STORE_MIGRATION_FRAMEWORK is 'versioned_sqlite_user_version_migration_ledger'.
StoreMigration pairs a schema version, a migration_id, and an apply function over a Connection.
StoreMigrationEvidence serializes migration framework, before/after schema versions, target version, applied-migration ids, pending count, and status.
store_migrations returns the ordered list of versioned SQLite store migrations (versions 1 through 11).
Store migration v1 creates the base local_projects and FTS tables.
Store migration v2 adds the editor_intents_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v3 adds the proposal_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v4 adds the selected_review_target_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v5 adds the mechanics_result_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v6 adds the analysis_run_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v7 adds the model_hash_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v8 adds the project_envelope_hash_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v9 adds an evidence-only model-document migration ledger column (DEC-019); the model-document schema version authority stays in-document.
Store migration v10 creates the local_rule_packs table; private rule packs stay in the local store and are never committed or transmitted (OPS-K-PRIV-1).
Store migration v11 creates the local_libraries table; only accepted PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY imports are written and private libraries are never committed or transmitted (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD section 13.5).
The local_rule_packs table is keyed by (project_id, rule_pack_id) and stores document_json with created/updated timestamps.
The local_libraries table is keyed by (project_id, library_kind, library_id) and stores document_json with created/updated timestamps.
migrate_v1_base_tables creates local_projects and a local_project_fts FTS5 virtual table over project_id, project_name, and model_text.
store_user_version reads the SQLite PRAGMA user_version as the store schema version.
open_project_store opens a SQLite connection at a path and applies store migrations, returning the connection and migration evidence.
Each store migration step is idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS / column probes) so legacy stores reconcile cleanly from version 0 without data loss.
apply_store_migrations enables foreign_keys and WAL journal mode, then applies each migration whose version exceeds the current user_version, advancing user_version and recording evidence.
ensure_column adds a column via ALTER TABLE only when PRAGMA table_info shows it is absent (idempotent column probe).
sqlite_compile_options reads the SQLite PRAGMA compile_options list.
fts5_available probes FTS5 support by creating and dropping a temporary fts5 table.
now_unix_seconds returns the current time as Unix epoch seconds.
project_name_from_model reads project.name from the model, defaulting to 'Untitled OpenPipeStress Project'.
project_id_from_model reads project.id from the model, defaulting to 'project:untitled-local'.
upsert_project inserts or updates a project row with all JSON-serialized envelope members and refreshes the FTS index in a single transaction.
The FTS search_text concatenates model, editor_intents, proposal, selected_review_target, and analysis_run JSON for full-text indexing.
StoredProjectRecord holds a loaded project's id, name, and deserialized envelope members.
load_project loads a project by id, or the most recently updated project when no id is given, deserializing each JSON envelope member.
list_projects returns project index entries ordered by most recent update then project_id.
normalized_editor_intents coerces editor_intents to a JSON array, defaulting to an empty array.
normalized_proposal coerces a proposal to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_selected_review_target coerces a selected review target to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_mechanics_result coerces a mechanics result to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_analysis_run coerces an analysis run to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_model_hash coerces a model hash to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_project_envelope_hash coerces a project-envelope hash to a JSON object, else Null.
proposal_count returns 1 when a proposal is an object, else 0.
editor_intent_count returns the number of editor-intent array entries.
selected_review_target_count returns 1 when a selected review target is an object, else 0.
object_count returns 1 when a value is an object, else 0.
persisted_analysis_run_ref resolves a run_id from analysis_run, falling back to mechanics_result, else 'not_persisted'.
persisted_model_hash_ref returns the model-hash value string, else 'not_persisted'.
persisted_project_envelope_hash_ref returns the envelope-hash value string, else 'not_persisted'.
selected_review_target_ref formats a selected review target as 'target_type: id', else 'not_selected'.
unit_round_trip_summary scans the model's units, materials, sections, pipe segments, and load cases to build a unit-reference signature and a preserved-or-missing status.
unit_round_trip status is 'unit_metadata_preserved_in_local_project_envelope' only when unit refs exist with no missing refs; otherwise review is required.
collect_quantity_unit records a quantity's unit reference, or marks the reference missing when a value has no unit.
value_id reads an object's id field, defaulting to 'unidentified'.
project_summary assembles a LocalProjectSummary from project identity, model, database path, migration evidence, and persisted-artifact counts and refs.
Tauri command get_unit_catalog returns the desktop unit catalog response.

Tauri command render_calculation_report deterministically renders hash-bound HTML with three-point protected-content gates and a non-hash-bound derived print view naming the canonical hash (DEC-021 / A7).
Tauri command load_preview_model reads the bundled invented_preview_model.json fixture.
Tauri command load_design_knowledge reads the bundled invented_design_knowledge.json fixture.
solve_preview_mechanics deserializes a PreviewModel and runs run_linear_static_preview with no extra materials.
resolve_solve_model_payload returns the supplied model, or the bundled invented_preview_model.json fixture when none is supplied.
Tauri command run_preview_mechanics solves the supplied or bundled preview model synchronously.
SOLVE_JOB_CANCELLATION_SCOPE is 'cooperative_checkpoints_not_preemptive' — solve-job cancellation is cooperative, not preemptive.
SolveJobStartReceipt carries the job_id, backend cancellation token, state, and cancellation scope of a started solve job.
SolveJobStatusReport reports a solve job's state, cancellation request/status, scope, optional result, and optional error message.
SolveJobCancellationReceipt reports whether a cancellation was accepted, its status, the job state, scope, and that no cancellation-success is claimed.
SolveJobRecord holds an in-flight solve job's cancellation token, state, cancellation flags, result, and error message.
SolveJobTable is the in-memory registry of solve jobs keyed by job_id with a monotonic next_job_number.
SolveJobRegistry wraps the solve-job table in an Arc<Mutex<>> for Tauri-managed shared state.
lock_solve_jobs acquires the solve-job table lock, mapping a poisoned lock to an error.
start_solve_job allocates a new job number, builds a job_id and cancellation token, and inserts a queued SolveJobRecord.
execute_solve_job marks a job running (or cancelled if cancellation was requested before start), solves, and publishes the outcome.
publish_solve_outcome records a solve job's completed/failed result, or discards the result when cancellation was requested before publication.
solve_job_status returns the status report for a known solve job, erroring for an unknown job_id.
cancel_solve_job validates the cancellation token, rejects requests after terminal states, and otherwise records a cooperative cancellation request without claiming success.
Tauri command start_preview_mechanics_job starts a background solve job on a spawned thread and returns the start receipt.
Tauri command poll_preview_mechanics_job returns the status of a solve job by id.
Tauri command cancel_preview_mechanics_job requests cancellation of a solve job using its id and cancellation token.
build_sample_agent_proposal builds a review-only agent proposal from computed mechanics that does not mutate accepted model state and makes no compliance/approval claim.
The sample agent proposal asserts the model is invented and not a project basis, and that no protected criteria, allowables, or owner-standard values are available.
Tauri command sample_agent_proposal returns a sample agent proposal, computing preview mechanics first when no result is supplied.
Tauri command validate_model_operation validates a structured model operation against a model and optional claimed hash without mutating it.
Tauri command apply_model_operation applies a structured operation to a model and returns the outcome.
Tauri command get_local_storage_capability opens the project store and reports the storage capability and migration evidence.
Storage path policy is app-local user data path with no repository-default writes.
Large-file policy references external files by path/hash metadata and does not silently copy large files.
refuse_model_document formats a refusal message reporting status and source/target schema versions for a refused model document.
hash_value_string reads a hash object's value string, defaulting to 'not_reported'.

prepare_model_document_for_persist resolves the model document, migration status, and ledger to persist for create/save (DEC-019): refusing unsupported/newer documents, migrating older ones, and appending a ledger record for a migrated document.
Persisting refuses model documents whose status is newer_than_supported, unsupported_schema, or failed.
When the open-time status was 'migrated', persisting records a migration ledger entry even though the incoming document is already current in memory.
A migration ledger record is appended with pre- and post-migration model hashes and a Unix timestamp when a migrated document is persisted (DEC-019).
Tauri command create_local_project normalizes envelope members, prepares the model document for persist, upserts the project, and returns the project envelope.
Tauri command open_local_project loads a project, migrates the restored document in memory when a chain applies, and refuses newer/unsupported documents for editing (DEC-019).
Tauri command list_local_projects returns the local project index.
Tauri command save_local_project normalizes envelope members from the request, prepares the model document for persist, upserts the project, and returns the envelope.

Rule packs are separate user-controlled documents, not members of the preview model document; they persist only in the local SQLite store (local_rule_packs, store v10) and are never committed, transmitted, or exported by default (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD section 17.3).

Rule-pack validation and checksum computation route through core/rules; statuses are software findings only and never professional, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance claims (OPS-K-AUTH-1).
LocalRulePackIndexEntry serializes a rule-pack index row: project id, rule_pack id/name/version, lifecycle status, privacy class, storage mode, and timestamps.
LocalRulePackEnvelope bundles a stored rule pack with its validation result and a message.
LocalRulePackDeleteReceipt reports whether a rule pack was deleted and a message.
rule_pack_document_string reads a JSON-pointer string from a rule-pack document, defaulting to 'TBD'.
rule_pack_id_from_document requires a non-empty metadata.rule_pack_id and errors otherwise.
rule_pack_validation_value validates a rule-pack document (optionally for public export) and returns the validation result as JSON.
StoredRulePackRow holds a loaded rule-pack document with created/updated timestamps.
upsert_rule_pack inserts or updates a rule-pack document keyed by (project_id, rule_pack_id), preserving created_at on conflict.
load_rule_pack loads a stored rule-pack document by project_id and rule_pack_id.
list_rule_packs lists rule packs, optionally scoped to a project, surfacing metadata fields from each document.
delete_rule_pack deletes a rule-pack row and returns whether any row was affected.
Tauri command validate_rule_pack validates a rule-pack document, defaulting public_export_requested to false.

Tauri command run_rule_checks runs a rule pack's checks against a solved model and returns per-check outcomes; a pack with blocking validation findings is reported RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE without running checks (completion plan C4).

run_rule_checks resolves private_library_value inputs from the local private-library store at run time; a reference that cannot be resolved is omitted so the input stays unsupplied and the check blocks — never a silent pass.
run_rule_checks_core is store-free rule-check orchestration; the Tauri command resolves library references into library_value_bindings before calling it, and tests target it directly.
A rule-check run with blocking rule-pack validation findings returns aggregate_status RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with empty checks and a professional-boundary notice.

Solver values for solver_result inputs come from an authored in-pack solver_result_ref (canonical) and legacy caller-supplied {input_id, result_id} selectors (fallback); an authored reference governs its input alone and the caller selector for that input is dropped.
A rule-check run sets current status MechanicsSolved only when the envelope's status.mechanics is MECHANICS_SOLVED, otherwise ModelIncomplete.
resolve_rule_check_project_id resolves the library-lookup project id from an explicit id, else model /project/id, else the solved envelope /model_ref.

resolve_library_value_bindings resolves each private_library_value input carrying a library_value_ref to a binding by reading the referenced slot from the local private-library store; unresolvable references are omitted so the input blocks, never a silent pass.
resolve_library_value_bindings_with_connection is the store-bound core of library-value resolution, separated so tests can drive it with an in-memory connection.

extract_library_slot_value reads {value, unit} from a library record's value slot for material, section, or component kinds; material values carry value.unit_ref.ref_id while section/component values carry a plain value.unit string.
Material library_value_ref targets material_records[material_id].allowables[allowable_id], the user_rule_allowable / private_reference rule-check source.
Section library_value_ref targets section_records[section_id].dimensions[dimension_id] or properties[property_id].
Component library_value_ref targets component_records[component_id].fields[field_id].

extract_library_slot_value returns None (so the binding is omitted and the check blocks) when the kind is unknown or the record/slot/value is absent or non-numeric; the private value is read at run time and never embedded in the rule pack (IP boundary).
find_library_slot_value looks up a record by record_id_key in records_member, scans each (slot_array, slot_id_key) in order, and returns the first matching slot's value object, or None.
parse_quantity_magnitude parses a library quantity magnitude that may be a JSON number or a numeric string, returning None when absent or non-numeric.
parse_library_value_bindings parses caller-resolved {input_id, value, unit, library_kind, library_id, record_id, slot_id} library values for private_library_value inputs.
solver_result_row_value reads {value, unit} from a solved envelope results row whose id matches result_id, returning None when no row matches or the row lacks a numeric value or string unit.

resolve_solver_result_bindings resolves caller-supplied {input_id, result_id} selectors against the solved envelope results, omitting a selector with no matching row so the input blocks; an authored solver_result_ref supersedes this legacy path.

resolve_authored_solver_result_bindings resolves each solver_result input carrying an authored solver_result_ref to a binding and returns the set of input ids carrying an authored reference (resolvable or not).

An authored solver_result_ref governs its input alone: the caller cannot override or rescue it at run time, and an unresolvable reference yields no binding so the input blocks at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
parse_supplied_value_bindings parses caller-supplied {ref_id, value, unit, dimension} user values for user_supplied_rule_value inputs and value-slot limits.
Tauri command compute_rule_pack_document_checksum computes a rule-pack document checksum via the rule_pack_document crate.
Tauri command save_local_rule_pack stores a rule-pack document to the local SQLite store only; drafts with findings remain saveable and are never transmitted or committed.
Tauri command open_local_rule_pack loads a rule-pack document from the local SQLite store with its validation result.
Tauri command list_local_rule_packs lists rule packs, optionally scoped to a project.
Tauri command delete_local_rule_pack deletes a rule-pack document from the local SQLite store and reports the outcome.

The library-import validation seam exposes the runtime library-import provenance crate (the DEL-03-07 port) so the GUI import wizard can validate a parsed material/section/component import payload before storing it; validation is a pure function with no persistence or file parsing.

Library-import validation statuses are software findings only; the command makes no legal license, redistribution, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance determination (OPS-K-AUTH-1, IP boundary), and unsupported library_kind / intended_visibility tokens are rejected, never guessed.

LIBRARY_IMPORT_BOUNDARY_NOTICE states library-import validation reports software findings only and makes no legal license, redistribution, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance determination.
library_import_validation_value validates an import payload via validate_library_import_tokens, flags blocking/quarantine findings, and returns a JSON validation envelope with the boundary notice.
Tauri command validate_library_import validates an import payload for a given library_kind and intended_visibility.

Imported material/section/component libraries persist in the local SQLite store only (local_libraries, store v11) and are never committed, transmitted, or exported by default (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD section 13.5, section 17.3).
The private-library store is private-by-default: save re-validates every document with intended_visibility 'private' and only stores an accepted (PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY) import.

Suspected-protected (QUARANTINE) and otherwise-blocked (REJECTED) library imports are refused — their findings are returned but nothing is written — a conservative IP-boundary posture differing from the rule-pack store.
LocalLibraryIndexEntry serializes a library index row: project id, library kind/id/name, privacy class, storage mode, and timestamps.
LocalLibraryEnvelope bundles a stored library document with its validation result and a message.
LocalLibrarySaveResult reports whether a library import was stored, with optional timestamps, the document, validation, and a message.
LocalLibraryDeleteReceipt reports whether a library was deleted and a message.
StoredLibraryRow holds a loaded library document with created/updated timestamps.
library_metadata_key maps library_kind material/section/component to its metadata key, rejecting unsupported kinds.
library_id_from_document requires a non-empty <kind>_library.library_id and errors otherwise.
library_document_string reads a library document metadata field string, defaulting to 'TBD'.
library_import_is_storable returns the import-validation envelope's accepted flag — only an accepted PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY import may be written; REJECTED/QUARANTINE imports are refused.
upsert_library inserts or updates a library document keyed by (project_id, library_kind, library_id), preserving created_at on conflict.
load_library loads a stored library document by project_id, library_kind, and library_id.
list_libraries lists libraries, optionally scoped to a project, surfacing name and privacy_class from each document.
delete_library deletes a library row scoped by project, kind, and id and returns whether any row was affected.
Tauri command save_local_library re-validates an import at the private boundary and stores it only when accepted; a blocked/quarantine import returns its validation without persisting.
Tauri command open_local_library loads a library document from the local SQLite store with a re-run private-visibility validation.
Tauri command list_local_libraries lists libraries, optionally scoped to a project.
Tauri command delete_local_library deletes a library document from the local SQLite store and reports the outcome.
run() builds the Tauri application, manages the SolveJobRegistry, and registers the invoke_handler with all desktop commands.

The Tauri invoke_handler registers commands including load_preview_model, run_preview_mechanics, the solve-job commands, project/rule-pack/library storage commands, run_rule_checks, and render_calculation_report.

Module implements model-document schema versioning and migration per DEC-019 (decision D-08).
Policy: the in-document `schema_version` (semver) is the sole authority for the model-document schema version; the SQLite `user_version` ledger remains DDL-only.
Policy: migration runs in memory on open and persists only on save; stored bytes are never rewritten as a side effect of open.
Policy: `newer_than_supported` and `unsupported_schema` documents are refused for editing with structured diagnostics — never coerced, never down-migrated.
Policy: saving a migrated document writes a per-document ledger record with the pre- and post-migration model hashes.
`SUPPORTED_MODEL_SCHEMA_VERSION` is the current model-document schema version the application can author; set to "0.2.0".

DEC-033 (2026-06-12): schema 0.2.0 adds the optional combination shape fields introduced by TP-APP-R2-COMBEXPR-001; any change to what a document can contain bumps minor, with patch reserved for non-shape changes.
`MODEL_MIGRATION_FRAMEWORK` is the framework label "application_service_separate_db_and_product_schema", fixed by `schemas/project_persistence.schema.yaml` and accepted in DEC-019.
`ModelDocumentMigration` struct defines a transform step with source_version, target_version, migration_id, and an `apply` function `fn(&Value) -> Result<Value, String>`.
`model_document_migrations()` returns the published transform chain.

The `0.1.0 -> 0.2.0` migration (DEC-033) is a documented no-op: the 0.2.0 shape only adds optional combination members, so every valid 0.1.0 document is a valid 0.2.0 document unchanged; the chain walker stamps the target schema_version.
The published `0.1.0 -> 0.2.0` migration id is "model-doc-0.1.0-to-0.2.0-additive-combination-shape-noop" and its apply clones the document unchanged.

`ModelDocumentMigrationStatus` struct captures migration outcome: status, source/target schema versions, migration_framework, db/product schema migration status, applied_migration_ids, persistence_state, and detail.
`EvaluatedModelDocument` carries an optional `migrated_document` (None when stored document is already current or evaluation refused it) plus the migration status.
`SemVer(u64,u64,u64)` is an ordered triple type used to compare schema versions.
`parse_semver` parses a `major.minor.patch` string into SemVer, returning None for invalid or extra-component versions.
The `status` helper builds a ModelDocumentMigrationStatus, fixing db_migration_status to "store_user_version_ledger_separate_ddl_only" and setting target to SUPPORTED_MODEL_SCHEMA_VERSION.
`evaluate_model_document` evaluates a document against the supported schema version and transform chain and never mutates the input document.
A document with no valid semver schema_version is classified "unsupported_schema" and refused for editing without coercion (persistence_state not_applicable_document_refused).
A document whose version equals the supported version is classified "current" with persistence_state "stored_document_current" and no migration applied.
A document newer than the supported version is classified "newer_than_supported" and refused for editing with no down-migration.
For documents older than supported, the evaluator walks the ordered transform chain step by step until reaching the supported version.
When the walk reaches the supported version, status is "migrated" with persistence_state "in_memory_only_not_yet_saved"; stored bytes are unchanged until save.
If no chain step matches the current version, status is "unsupported_schema" with detail "No migration path exists ...", refusing to open without coercion.
On a successful step apply, the walker stamps the next document's schema_version to the step target_version (inserting the key if absent) and records the migration id.
If a transform step returns Err, status is "failed" with no migrated document and detail naming the failing migration id.
`migration_ledger_record` builds the per-document ledger record written when a migrated document is persisted (DEC-019 evidence guarantee).

The migration ledger record has record_kind "model_document_migration_ledger_record" and carries recorded_at_unix, source/target schema versions, applied_migration_ids, migration_framework, and pre/post migration model hashes.
The migration ledger record sets trigger "migrate_in_memory_on_open_persisted_on_save" and destructive_rewrite false.
The migration ledger record embeds a professional_boundary block: human_review_required true, software_makes_compliance_claim false, software_makes_approval_claim false.

The dead-control audit (TP-APP-R2-UXSHELL-001) is a permanent regression test prompted by a packaged-app smoke report (SMOKE.md TP-MAC-141 attempt 2) of unresponsive controls.

The audit renders the full shell, enumerates every button (the shell's only clickable control primitive besides plain links), and requires each to be either responsive when clicked or disabled with an accessible reason.
Acceptance (a): a control is enabled and wired so clicking produces an observable DOM change within the audit window.
Acceptance (b): a control is disabled with an accessible reason — non-empty title, aria-label, or aria-describedby target text.

Audit method: controls are normalized into classes (entity ids and sequence numbers stripped from data-testid) and one representative per class is audited on a fresh render so clicks cannot contaminate each other.

The audit covers three shell states: initial fixture state, queued state (one explicit-node intent queued), and solved state (mechanics preview completed), because some controls only exist in later authoring phases.

Documented exemption: a button with aria-pressed="true" at click time is an already-active toggle/filter; re-selecting it is idempotent by design and produces no DOM change, so active toggles are not counted as dead.
The audit uses AUDIT_TIMEOUT_MS of 600,000 ms and CLICK_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS of 3,000 ms.
`normalizeKey` derives a control class key from data-testid (splitting on ":" and replacing digits with "#") or from the aria-label/text label when no testid exists.
`enumerateButtons` collects all `button` and `[role="button"]` elements in the container.
`isDisabled` treats a control as disabled when its `disabled` property is set or `aria-disabled="true"`.
`disabledReason` returns the first non-empty accessible reason from title, aria-label, or aria-describedby target text, else null.

`renderReadyShell` renders the App, waits for the "desktop-preview-shell" testid, and waits (up to 15s) for a terminal engine state (engine_state ready or unavailable) so click observations are not confused with warmup re-renders.

`prepareScenario` sets up audit state: "initial" is a no-op; "queued" queues one load-magnitude intent via the load-case manager; "solved" runs the mechanics preview and waits for solve state=completed.
`findRepresentative` finds the first enumerated button whose normalized key matches a given control class, else null.

`auditScenario` enumerates control classes on a render, then for each unaudited class re-renders fresh, locates the representative, and checks disabled-reason or post-click DOM change, recording violations.
A control class that disappears between enumeration and audit render is recorded as a violation indicating non-deterministic shell state.
An enabled control that produces no observable DOM change after click is recorded as a violation (dead control).
Test assertion: every button is either responsive or disabled with a stated reason; violation report must equal empty list.
Audit sanity floor: the audited control-class count must exceed 40, otherwise the audit itself is considered broken.

App imports operation engine services: applyModelOperation, validateModelOperation, warmupOperationEngine, and initialOperationEngineStatus from ./services/operationService.
App imports local project services: buildBlankLocalModelDocument, createLocalProject, getLocalStorageCapability, listLocalProjects, openLocalProject, saveLocalProject from ./services/projectService.
App imports computeModelHash and computeProjectEnvelopeHash from ./services/hashService for model and envelope integrity hashing.
SessionModelCheckpoint type captures checkpoint_id, operation_id, model (PreviewModel) and selection (EntityRef) for undo/redo session history.

Workspace information architecture (TP-APP-R2-UXSHELL-001): persistent spatial core (model tree, 3D centerline viewport, property inspector) stays on screen; all other panels sit behind section navigation listed in A12 journey order (model entities -> loads -> solve -> results -> report).

Rule-pack manager (Phase C2, TP-C2-EDITOR-001) is placed between loads and solve because user rule checks consume authored loads and feed the solve/check journey (PRD section 22.4); the private library manager (Phase C3, TP-C3-LIBGUI-001) precedes it because both are private local-only asset managers and rule packs reference imported library allowables.
WorkspaceSectionId union enumerates the dock sections: operations, loads, libraries, rule-packs, solve, results, report, project, exports, evidence.
WORKSPACE_SECTIONS constant defines each dock section's id, label, and description (e.g. operations = queued structured operations apply/undo/redo and review ledger).
Libraries section description: private, local-only library manager importing material/section/component libraries with provenance, validation findings, and the local store.
Rule-packs section description: private, local-only rule-pack manager with drafts, validation findings, checksum generation, and the local store.

JourneyStepId union and JourneyStep type model the guided journey rail steps (model, loads, private-libraries, rule-pack, solve-check, results, report, save-reopen) each bound to a WorkspaceSectionId.

A12FlowStepId union and A12FlowStep type model the A12 authoring flow steps (blank, nodes, material, section, pipe, support, load-case, primitive-load, combination, solve, report, save-reopen) with cue, complete and status fields.
GuidedJourneyMode union ('a12' | 'r3') selects between A12 authoring journey and R3 rule-check journey.
R3FlowStepId union and R3FlowStep type model the R3 rule-pack flow steps: library, rule-pack, checksum-save, solve, bind, run.

R3JourneyEvent union enumerates recordable R3 journey events (library_template_loaded, library_validate_requested, rule_pack_draft_created, rule_pack_checksum_requested, rule_check_run_requested, etc.); R3JourneyState is a Record mapping each event to a boolean.
INITIAL_R3_JOURNEY_STATE initializes every R3 journey event flag to false.
JOURNEY_STEPS constant lists the eight guided journey steps with id, label, section, and description in journey order.

App() is the root React component holding session state via useState: model, knowledge, selection, result, analysisRun, ruleCheckAggregate, proposal, editorIntents, project summary/index, hashes, migration ledger, solveJob, and UI flags.
ruleCheckAggregate state holds the worst-of GUI rule-check aggregate, lifted so it can be recorded in the app-held analysis-run envelope (TP-C4-APPAGG-001).
comparison is memoized via buildPreviewComparison when both result and analysisRun exist; otherwise null.
On mount, App loads preview model, design knowledge, and local storage capability concurrently (Promise.all) and sets initial selection via defaultSelection.
App recomputes modelHash whenever model changes, clearing the hash first then setting it from computeModelHash.
App warms up the operation engine on mount; browser mode lazily loads the wasm32 operation_applier build, and an absent artifact surfaces as an explicit unavailable status, never a fallback.

handleRun starts a preview mechanics job; a fresh solve invalidates any prior rule-check aggregate; backend_job mode awaits the backend job to a terminal state, browser mode runs preview mechanics inline.
handleRun throws if a backend solve job ends in a non-completed state or without a result, surfacing the backend error message.
On solve completion handleRun builds the analysis-run preview record, completes the solve job, sets result, and clears proposal/review target.

handleRuleCheckAggregate records (or clears) the GUI rule-check aggregate in the app-held analysis-run envelope; rebuilding re-derives only the analysis_run_record status/hash, while the embedded result_envelope hash still binds the raw solve, so the hash-bound solve envelope is never mutated.
If recording the rule-check aggregate fails (e.g. hashing unavailable), handleRuleCheckAggregate keeps the solve-time analysis-run envelope rather than surfacing a false outcome.
recordR3JourneyEvent idempotently sets an R3 journey event flag to true, ignoring already-set events.
handleCancelRun requests solve cancellation; for tauri backend jobs it calls cancelPreviewMechanicsJob with the backend cancellation token and records the receipt or failure.
handleProposal loads a sample agent proposal scoped to the current result and selected review target.
handleQueueEditorIntent assigns a monotonic queue_id (editor-intent-N) and prepends the intent to the editor intents queue.
handleValidateIntent calls validateModelOperation for a queued intent and records the outcome keyed by intentKey, setting an error message on failure.

handleApplyIntent applies a queued model operation; if application_status is not 'applied_to_session_model' or no applied_model is returned, it reports the operation was not applied and returns without mutating the model.

On successful apply, handleApplyIntent builds an AppliedOperationReceipt recording sequence, operation_id, change_id, target type/ref, field_path, before/after, application_route, applied_model_hash, acceptance, diagnostics, and professional_boundary.
handleApplyIntent pushes an undo checkpoint (capped at 25), clears the redo stack, sets the applied model, and resolves the next selection (default selection on delete operations).

After applying an operation, prior solve output no longer describes the edited model document, so result/analysisRun/ruleCheckAggregate/proposal/review target are cleared and the user is told to run a new solve then save.
handleUndoSessionModelEdit pops the undo stack, pushes a redo checkpoint, restores the checkpoint model and selection, and clears computed model state (solve still required to persist).
handleRedoSessionModelEdit pops the redo stack, pushes an undo checkpoint, restores the model/selection, and clears computed model state.
clearComputedModelState resets result, analysisRun, ruleCheckAggregate, proposal, and selectedReviewTarget and installs the provided next solve job.

handleCreateProject computes the project envelope hash then createLocalProject persists model, editor intents, proposal, review target, result, analysisRun, modelHash, and envelopeHash, updating summary and migration ledger.
handleCreateBlankProject builds a blank local model document with no fixture entities or external file copies, persists it, and resets all session/edit/result state.

handleOpenProject opens a local project by id (or default); if none found it reports open_missing; otherwise it restores model/result/analysisRun/intents and recomputes model and envelope hash integrity on open.
On open, handleOpenProject derives model-hash integrity and project-envelope-hash integrity by recomputing hashes from the restored model and comparing against the persisted values.
handleSaveProject computes the envelope hash and saveLocalProject persists model, intents, proposal, review target, result, analysisRun, modelHash, envelopeHash, and modelDocumentMigration.
handleListProjects lists local project snapshots from the local store index and reports the count.
handleSelectResult sets the selected review target to a result and resolves the entity selection via resolveEntitySelection.
handleSelectDiagnostic sets the selected review target to a diagnostic and resolves the entity selection via resolveDiagnosticEntitySelection.

Modeling workspace renders the persistent spatial core: ModelTree, PipeViewport (with queue-intent/select handlers), and PropertyInspector.
Workspace dock renders the GuidedWorkbench plus a section nav and the dock body containing one section per WorkspaceSectionId.
Operations dock section renders OperationApplyPanel and a collapsible review-apply drawer with EditorContractPanel, DiffPreviewPanel, OperationLedgerPanel, and AgentProposalPanel.

dockSectionClass returns 'workspace-dock-section' for the active section and adds 'inactive' otherwise.

a12StepClass builds CSS classes for an A12 step adding 'complete', 'next', and 'selected' modifiers based on completion, next-step, and active-step state.

buildA12FlowState derives A12 authoring progress from the model: counts materials, sections, combinations, and primitive loads; solved = result has rows and mechanics status MECHANICS_SOLVED; reportReady requires solved plus analysisRun.

report_protected_content_lint export is a heuristic public report-surface lint whose clean output is not legal, redaction, release, or professional clearance.
handoff_package export is a native open JSON preview profile with target-specific solver mapping deferred.
operation_review_ledger export records held-for-user-acceptance review records only, applying no accepted-state mutation.
Export review redaction_policy: public/shared export not allowed, local private export allowed, private values redacted, protected content blocked, source model not mutated.
Export review is a local technical-preview manifest only; it does not certify redaction, release readiness, or professional acceptance.

ExportUnitSystemDisclosure type records unit_system_ref, model/result/target units, conversion policy/scope, decision basis refs, and storage_convention entered_units_preserved with no protected or private payload.

buildExportUnitSystemDisclosure builds a DEC-018 unit-system disclosure preserving entered units, recording target export units, conversion policy/scope, and decision basis refs DEC-018 and DEL-02-02.
unitDisclosureSummary formats a one-line summary of source units, target units, result units, and whether conversion was performed.
formatUnitRecord renders a sorted comma-joined key=value list of unit entries, returning none when empty.
ExternalProverBoundaryPanel builds and renders the external-prover boundary metadata packet from model, result, and analysisRun.

buildExternalProverBoundaryPacket assembles non-authoritative external-prover workflow metadata: names, tags, notes, external references, attachments, context links, unsupported flags, and diagnostics (DEL-15-04).
External-prover attachments carry payload_embedded false and content-hash references only, with no payload ingestion.
unsupported_target_flags record external_solver_not_invoked, commercial_result_ingestion_deferred, and formal_prover_status_not_generated as not_implemented.
externalProverDiagnostics emit EPM-DESKTOP-METADATA-ONLY, EXTERNAL-EXECUTION-NOT-INVOKED, COMMERCIAL-RESULT-NOT-INGESTED, and an authority-flags diagnostic.
tbdChecksum produces a TBD-algorithm checksum reference scoped to the project when no run hashes are available.

External-prover professionalBoundary asserts metadata_only true; external_tool_invoked, commercial_result_payload_ingested, and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication/reliance claims false.
External-prover metadata is descriptive review context only; external tools, target parsers, and human-owned acceptance records remain outside this preview packet.
HandoffPanel React component renders a local review handoff package from a preview model, knowledge, mechanics result, analysis run, comparison, editor intents, proposal, and selected review target.
Handoff package is exported as a downloadable local JSON file named openpipestress-preview-handoff-<token>.json via a data URI, with no server upload.
buildHandoffPackage assembles a handoff package document of kind openpipestress.technical_preview.handoff_package with export_scope local_browser_download_preview.

Handoff loss report declares delegated, omitted, approximated, and unsupported behavior references; unsupported items include that protected code/rule criteria are not bundled and target-specific commercial-solver field mapping is not generated.
Handoff stable_id_map records id_basis as model entity IDs and computed result IDs, with entity_refs and selected_result_refs as stable cross-reference anchors.
Handoff target_mapping uses profile native_open_json_preview with mapping_status stable_ids_only_not_target_specific and policy loss_report_required_before_target_specific_export.
Handoff package asserts release_or_professional_claim is false and professional_boundary requires human review while making no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.
stableEntityRefs returns a sorted list of stable entity IDs spanning project, materials, nodes, pipe_segments, supports, components, load_cases, and combinations.
handoffBoundary returns a local-review-only boundary string when human review is required and no compliance/approval claim, private payload, protected content, or professional claim is present.
safeFileToken sanitizes a value to a filesystem-safe download token, defaulting to 'preview'.
HeadlessRunnerPanel renders a schema-first headless runner envelope from a preview model, mechanics result, analysis run, and solve-job audit state.
Headless runner output is a local schema-first preview envelope only; final CLI syntax, package scripts, process policy, network policy, filesystem mutation policy, CI, and release matrix remain TBD.
buildHeadlessRunnerPacket builds a runner packet (deliverable DEL-10-05, package PKG-10) with runner_status, tbd_decisions, a solve request, and a result handoff.
Headless runner_status interface_kind is schema_first_headless_runner_contract with final_cli_command_syntax, package_scripts, transport protocol, CI provider, and release matrix all TBD.

physicalProjectContainer declares an sqlite_local_project_store profile (decision SCA-003) where canonical truth is canonical_json_jcs_payload, SQL is not a public contract, no direct SQL or hosted DB access, and no network is required.
runnerDiagnostic normalizes a diagnostic into a runner diagnostic with code, class, severity (error mapped to blocking), source, affected_object, message, remediation, and provenance.
runnerDiagnosticClass classifies a diagnostic as RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, UNIT_WARNING, RUNNER_BLOCKING, or ASSUMPTION_WARNING based on its code and severity.
jobState maps a solve-job state to one of QUEUED, RUNNING, CANCELLATION_REQUESTED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, FAILED, or TBD.
privacyContext declares local_only true, telemetry_allowed false, private_payload_redacted true, and classification public_metadata.
professionalBoundary asserts human review is required and the software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.
previewProvenance attributes preview data to an invented preview fixture under a project-invented license with review_status accepted and no protected or private payload.
KnowledgePanel renders design-knowledge records combining stored knowledge records with physics records derived from the mechanics result.
physicsRecords derives computed_mechanics_context knowledge records from warning/blocking result diagnostics and from the computed max-displacement and axial-force summaries.
Computed displacement review record summarizes the max_displacement result_ref with its value, unit, and location_ref and is marked status human_review_required.
Axial-force knowledge record is located by result id result:force:pipe-P-120:axial or by kind element_local_axial_force.

Library manager browser-preview tests pin the desktop-only seam (Phase C3 TP-C3-LIBGUI-001): jsdom has no Tauri runtime, so import documents stay in memory and backend actions report an explicit unavailable diagnostic instead of a synthesized fallback.
A blocked library-import validation has outcome QUARANTINE with blocking findings IMPORT_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED, IMPORT_LIBRARY_METADATA_MISSING, and advisory IMPORT_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Backend library actions in browser preview report the diagnostic LIBRARY-IMPORT-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY and never invoke the Tauri backend.
Validation findings are split along the PRD §13.5 blocking-vs-advisory axis: blocking/quarantine findings block acceptance while review_required findings are advisory.
DEC-036 refuse-to-store: a blocked import yields stored=false and is not written to the local store, while the blocked validation still rides through to the §13.5 display.
buildInventedLibraryImportTemplate builds a private-by-default, provenance-complete document per kind with privacy_class private_user_data, empty records, and redistribution_status private_only.

Private Library Manager (PRD §13/§14.6) imports an already-parsed material/section/component library document, validates it through the DEL-03-07 provenance seam, and persists accepted private imports to the local-only store.

The local library store is private-by-default and persists only an accepted PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY import; a suspected-protected (QUARANTINE) or otherwise-blocked (REJECTED) import is refused and never written (DEC-036).

Imported private libraries are never transmitted, committed, or bundled into public artifacts (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD §13.5/§17.3); every status is a software finding only, never a legal, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance determination.
Supported library kinds are material library, section library, and component library.
Intended visibility options are private (local-only) and public (validation preview); visibility shapes the validation preview only while save always persists to the private local store.
An in-request busy guard disables the draft textarea, kind/visibility selectors, and actions while a backend command is awaiting, so an async response cannot clobber a mid-request edit.
The stored-library list is project-scoped and is cleared when the active project changes, while the authored session draft is intentionally preserved until saved.
parseDraft requires the import document to be a JSON object, reporting LIBRARY-IMPORT-DRAFT-JSON-INVALID for invalid JSON or non-object payloads.

handleValidate routes the draft through validateLibraryImport, partitions findings into blocking and advisory, and reports outcome, accepted, and finding counts; browser preview returns the unavailable diagnostic.
handleSave refuses without a loaded project, saves via saveLocalLibrary, and surfaces the DEC-036 refuse-to-store note when validation findings block the library.

Library boundary note states imported private libraries stay in local project storage only, only an accepted private import is stored (DEC-036), and validation reports software findings, never a legal or professional acceptance claim.
Primitive load categories form a closed set: concentrated_force, distributed_force, concentrated_moment, pressure, thermal, and imposed_displacement.
Combination basis options form a closed set mirroring core/loads/load_case_algebra vocabulary: mechanics, result_state_subtraction, and range_envelope.
Combination range-envelope modes are min, max, min_abs, and max_abs.
LoadCaseManagerPanel manages load cases, primitive loads, and combinations, queuing edits as structured EditorOperationIntent objects via onQueueIntent rather than mutating the model directly.

Load edits are queued as structured operations, applied only after user action, and remain local-session changes until saved; the panel does not add rule-code combinations, protected standards content, or professional approval.

loadMetadataOptions collects distinct status/kind values across load cases plus TBD and a field-specific default (preview_only for status, primitive_user_load for kind), sorting the current value first and TBD last.
nextLoadCaseIdentifier allocates the first unused load:L-<index> id starting at index 300.
nextCombinationIdentifier allocates the first unused combination:C-<index> id starting at index 300.
isLoadCaseDraftReady requires non-empty id, label, kind, status, and provenance and a non-duplicate id before a create-load-case intent is allowed.
isPrimitiveLoadDraftReady requires a valid load case, unique id, existing target, valid direction, finite non-zero magnitude, provenance, and a non-TBD unit.

isCombinationDraftReady enforces basis-specific rules: subtraction needs distinct existing minuend/subtrahend; range_envelope needs unique existing operands and a valid mode; mechanics needs an existing load case and finite factor.

buildCreateLoadCaseIntent emits a structured create EditorOperationIntent (operation_kind create, status proposed, author_type user) targeting an empty load-case shell with primitive loads not inferred.

Every load-manager intent carries an audit_boundary with mutation_route structured_operations_only, direct_model_mutation_allowed false, requires_user_acceptance true, and mutates_accepted_model_state false.
Every load-manager intent carries a professional_boundary requiring human review and making no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.

combinationCreatePayload builds a basis-specific combination payload: subtraction with minuend_id/subtrahend_id, range_envelope with operand_ids/mode, or mechanics with a terms array of load_case and factor.
buildCreateCombinationIntent emits a create combination intent whose source_note records the basis and notes no code/rule combination default is inferred.
buildCreatePrimitiveLoadIntent builds a primitive-load payload with category, target (support/element/node), direction, magnitude value+unit, and dimension, defaulting unit to TBD when absent.
buildLoadMetadataIntent emits a modify update_load intent over a load-case status or kind field with the before value and proposed value (TBD when empty).
buildDeleteLoadCaseIntent emits a delete intent over the whole load-case entity, recording the display string as the before value and not_present as the after value.
buildCombinationBasisIntent emits a modify intent over a combination basis label, noting no code/rule combination default is inferred.
buildLoadMagnitudeIntent emits a modify update_load intent over primitive_loads.<i>.magnitude.value with source_note 'unit metadata required' and a JSON after-value of value and unit.
buildDeletePrimitiveLoadIntent emits a delete intent over an existing indexed primitive load only.
combinationDisplay must stay byte-identical to the engine's combination_delete_display so delete-intent before-state checks pass, formatting id, label, basis, and terms.

unitOptions builds selectable units from the Tauri unit catalog filtered by dimension, labeling each DEC-018 canonical or DEC-018 display, falling back to model metadata when the catalog is unavailable.
primitiveLoadDefaultUnit selects the project default unit per category: distributed_force/length, moment, pressure, temperature, rotation or length for imposed_displacement, else force.
primitiveLoadDraftDimension maps a category to a dimension: force_per_length, moment, pressure, temperature_interval, rotation/displacement, or force.
primitiveLoadUsesPipeTarget returns true for distributed_force, pressure, and thermal; primitiveLoadUsesSupportTarget returns true only for imposed_displacement.
primitiveLoadDirectionOptions returns UX/UY/UZ/RX/RY/RZ for imposed_displacement, rotation_x/y/z for concentrated_moment, and global_x/y/z otherwise.
primitiveLoadSourceNote records, per category, an explicit user-entered note asserting that other load categories (moments, pressure, temperature, imposed displacements) are not inferred.
parseFiniteNumber accepts only a strict signed decimal/exponent numeric string and returns a finite number or null.
Imposed-displacement primitive loads target supports with degrees of freedom UX/UY/UZ/RX/RY/RZ, where RX/RY/RZ are treated as rotational.

Rider test coverage for TP-SEAM-CORPUS-001: when the mechanics result summary lacks location references, the Local FEA handoff package must emit an explicit incomplete-state finding and degrade honestly, never inventing fixture entity references.
The former pipe:P-120 / node:N-140 fixture fallback references must not be invented as substitutes; all fixture data in the test is invented.
inventedModel() builds a PreviewModel test fixture with project units length=m, force=N, angle=rad, pressure=Pa, temperature=degC and analysis_status mechanics=ready.
inventedResult(summary) builds a MechanicsResult fixture with status mechanics=MECHANICS_SOLVED, rule_check=not_performed, professional_acceptance=not_provided.
inventedAnalysisRun() builds an AnalysisRunEnvelope fixture whose immutability_policy marks run records read-only, requires a new run for change, and invalidates external acceptance on hash change.
exportedPacket() reads the local-fea-export-link href data URL and returns the decoded handoff JSON payload string.
Test: when summary location refs are missing, the panel region shows local-region:stress-location-ref-missing:displacement-location-ref-missing with nodes=0, elements=0, and diagnostics=5.

Test: the exported packet contains LOCAL-FEA-RESULT-SUMMARY-REF-MISSING and the missing summary.max_open_formula_stress.location_ref and summary.max_displacement.location_ref fields, with no invented substitute references.

Test: when the summary carries location refs (max_displacement at node:N-2, max_open_formula_stress at pipe:P-1), the panel keeps the four standing findings, shows diagnostics=4, and the packet omits the REF-MISSING finding.
Type LocalFeaReference: a reference with ref_id, ref_kind, locator, path_is_user_supplied flag, and optional content_hash checksum.
Type LocalFeaChecksum: algorithm (sha256|sha512|TBD), canonicalization (JCS-compatible-json|external-file-native|none|TBD), payload_ref, and value.
Constant LOCAL_FEA_HANDOFF_VERSION = 0.1.0; HASH_STATUS_TBD declares the browser preview does not emit a local FEA package hash.
LocalFeaHandoffPanel(model, result, analysisRun) is a React panel that builds the local FEA handoff packet only when both result and analysisRun are present.

When no packet exists, the panel prompts the user to run the mechanics preview to assemble a target-neutral local shell/solid FEA handoff package with selected region, transfer-basis references, advisory labels, and explicit TBD flags.

Panel note: local FEA handoff output is target-neutral review context only; no mesh, external solver, target format, approval, authentication, certification, sealing, or code-compliance claim is generated.
buildLocalFeaHandoffPacket(model, result, analysisRun) assembles the local FEA handoff packet from the selected region, selected result refs, diagnostics, and run hashes.
The handoff packet declares deliverable_id DEL-10-03, package_id PKG-10, scope_items SOW-031 and SOW-049, and objective OBJ-009.

contract_status: contract_kind=schema_first_local_fea_handoff_contract; global role is primary global centerline frame model; local role is optional specialized shell/solid handoff; export format, solver adapter, mesh generation, and external solver invocation are TBD; professional_decision=human_review_required.

local_region selection_basis is diagnostic_suggested and carries selected entity ids, geometry refs, local detail refs, a global-preview coordinate system ref, and reason_labels including human_review_required.

guidance_assessment labels include local_detail_review_consider, local_shell_solid_handoff_consider, global_to_local_transfer_inputs_incomplete, and human_review_required, with all approval/compliance/certification/sealing claim flags false.
Handoff package privacy: local_only=true, telemetry_allowed=false, private_payload_embedded=false, classification=public_metadata_only, redaction_required_before_public_export=true.

selectedLocalRegion(model, result): no invented fallback references; when the result summary lacks a location_ref, the absence is surfaced as LOCAL-FEA-RESULT-SUMMARY-REF-MISSING and the region degrades honestly instead of borrowing fixture ids.
The region_id is composed from the stress element token (or stress-location-ref-missing) and the displacement node token (or displacement-location-ref-missing).
entityIds() returns the namespaced entity id set: component_ids, node_ids, element_ids, station_ids, load_case_ids, and result_ids for the selected region.
selectedResultRefs(result) gathers preferred result refs (max_displacement, max_open_formula_stress, and example force/moment/stress refs) filtered to those actually available in the result.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-MESH-NOT-GENERATED (LOCAL_HANDOFF_WARNING): mesh generation is not performed by the desktop technical preview.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-TARGET-FORMAT-TBD (LOCAL_HANDOFF_WARNING): the concrete local FEA exchange format and target solver adapter remain TBD.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-BOUNDARY-TRANSFER-REVIEW (LOCAL_HANDOFF_WARNING): boundary transfer is represented by result references only and requires human review.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-EXTERNAL-SOLVER-NOT-INVOKED (EXPORT_BLOCKING): no external shell or solid FEA solver is invoked by this package; external execution remains user-owned.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-RESULT-SUMMARY-REF-MISSING is appended (after the four standing findings) when result summary location refs are missing, stating no substitute entity references are invented.

unsupportedBehaviorFlags maps diagnostics to flags: mesh_generation_not_performed, target_format_not_selected, boundary_transfer_requires_review, local_detail_assumption_unresolved, and external_solver_not_invoked.
unitsManifest(model) derives the local FEA handoff unit manifest with moment_unit N*m, displacement_unit mm, rotation_unit rad, and stress/temperature units defaulting from the model project units.
reference(refKind, locator, pathIsUserSupplied=false) constructs a LocalFeaReference with a safe ref_id token.
professionalBoundary() declares human_review_required=true and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claim flags false.
safeRefToken/safeFileToken sanitize values to safe token strings, returning a default ('ref'/'preview') when empty.
Type GuiWarningClass enumerates SOLVE_BLOCKING, RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, ASSUMPTION_WARNING, NONLINEAR_WARNING, and IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING.

Type MissingDataWarning carries warning_id, warning_class, local_contract_class, severity, analysis_status, affected/source refs, message, remediation, and flags blocks_mechanics_solve, blocks_rule_check, qualifies_mechanics_results, private_data_required, protected_content_required.
MissingDataBlockingPanel(model, result) renders a missing-data blocking review panel from the built missing-data blocking packet.

Panel note: missing-data warnings distinguish mechanics solve readiness from user-rule checking; they do not fill missing engineering values and do not certify, approve, seal, authenticate, or declare code compliance.
buildMissingDataBlockingPacket(model, result) merges model and result diagnostics, separates mechanics/rule_check/professional_acceptance status inputs, and builds the warning set.

The missing-data packet declares document_kind openpipestress.technical_preview.missing_data_warning_blocking_review, deliverable DEL-07-04, package PKG-07, scope SOW-022, objectives OBJ-006 and OBJ-011.

Packet summary distinguishes mechanics_results_reviewable from mechanics_results_qualified_by_rule_inputs, and asserts silent_defaults_used=false, bundled_code_values_used=false, compliance_claim_made=false.
analysis_boundary_contract authority_model is mechanics_rule_human_acceptance_separated with human_acceptance_record_policy=external_hash_bound_human_record_only.
assistive_contract requires text fields class, severity, affected_refs, message, remediation, and forbids color-only signaling.
source_of_truth_boundary: the GUI is not source of truth; mutation route is diagnostic_display_only_no_model_defaulting; direct model mutation and accepted model state mutation are not allowed.
buildWarnings() constructs the active MissingDataWarning list from model/result status and diagnostics.

Warning solve-required-physical-inputs (SOLVE_BLOCKING, blocking) is raised when mechanics is incomplete or any diagnostic is blocking: mechanics solve-required data is incomplete; both solve and rule-check are blocked.

Warning rule-check-required-inputs (RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING) is raised when rule_check is incomplete: user-rule required inputs are absent so rule-check pass/fail and ratios stay blocked; private rule-pack criteria required.

Warning component-modifier-provenance (PROVENANCE_WARNING) is raised when component provenance includes no_flexibility_factor: component SIF or flexibility-factor provenance is absent; keep modifiers user-supplied, do not infer protected table values.

Warning code-combination-criteria-absent (RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING) is raised for load cases/combinations lacking code basis: load cases and combinations are mechanics inputs, not user-code rule combinations; supply private owner/code criteria.

Warning public-fixture-provenance-only (PROVENANCE_WARNING) is raised for invented public material/pipe-section fixtures: replace with user-controlled data and documented provenance before engineering reliance.

Warning professional-acceptance-not-provided (ASSUMPTION_WARNING) is raised when acceptance is not_provided: no hash-bound human acceptance record is attached; treat outputs as review context until human authority records acceptance outside the software.
isRuleIncomplete(status) returns true when the rule-check status contains incomplete, missing, or not_performed.
guiWarningClassStatusMap() maps each GUI warning class to its associated analysis-status tokens, all including HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
professionalBoundary() declares human_review_required=true with all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claim flags false.
ModelTree Props: model PreviewModel, current selection EntityRef, and onSelect(selection) callback.
ModelTree(model, selection, onSelect) renders the model entity tree with a filter, a project button, and grouped entity buttons; shows an empty message when the filter matches nothing.
Type TreeItem describes a tree node with id, type, label, optional detail, icon, and keywords; TreeModel/FilteredTreeModel hold the project, groups, and count.
TreeControls renders the model-tree filter input, a count summary ('N of M model entities visible'), and a clear-filter button.

buildTree(model) builds the tree with a project root and groups for Materials, Sections, Nodes, Pipe Segments, Supports, Components, Load Cases, and Combinations, each item carrying searchable keywords.
Empty groups are filtered out, and the tree count is 1 (project) plus the total number of grouped items.
provenanceKeyword(provenance) returns the string provenance directly or JSON-stringifies an object provenance.
filterTree(tree, filterText) returns the full tree for an empty query, otherwise keeps the project and group items whose keywords match the lowercased query.
matchesTreeItem(item, groupTitle, query) joins the item keywords, type, label, detail, and group title, lowercases them, and tests substring inclusion of the query.
TreeButton renders a selectable tree row with the item icon, label, optional detail, active styling, and aria-pressed state.
