PropertyInspector(model, selection, onQueueIntent, onValidateIntent, ...) renders entity properties and review-only edit/create/delete operation intent panels for the selected model entity.
The inspector derives editable field options for the selection and holds local draft state for proposed value, unit, rationale, and section/material/support creation drafts.

buildOperationIntent is invoked for the selected field to produce a structured edit intent; section/material/support create intents and node/pipe/support delete intents are built when their drafts/selections are valid.
On mount the inspector loads the unit catalog via loadUnitCatalog(), falling back to route unavailable_browser_preview with a UNIT-CATALOG-LOAD-FAILED diagnostic on error.
handleQueueIntent queues the operation intent only when a field actually changed; create handlers queue the draft intent and advance the draft to the next reserved id.
When no editable entity is selected, the inspector prompts the user to select an editable model entity to draft a structured operation intent.

InlineValidationPreview shows structured-operation validation status (mode, application_status, schema/unit/before_state), a diff preview, and either a validate-only boundary note or per-diagnostic findings.
InlineValidationPreview boundary note states the intent is validate-only with no accepted model mutation and no professional approval.
Type EditableField describes an editable field's label, fieldPath, before value, objectType, changeKind (set_field|update_load|update_support), dimension, unit, sourceNote, and unitEditable.
Types SupportDraft, MaterialDraft, SectionDraft, and UnitOption define the local creation draft shapes and the unit option (symbol/label).
Constant RESTRAINT_OPTIONS = [UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY, RZ] enumerates the support restraint directions.
OperationIntentPreview renders intent facts: operation, target, change, unit basis, validation, audit boundary, professional boundary, and rationale.
IntentQueue lists queued transient editor intents (queue_id, operation_id, change path before-to-after, application_status, mutates_accepted_model_state) or an empty message.

unitOptions(route, dimensionId, fallbackSymbol) returns unit options from the tauri_unit_catalog filtered to the dimension, sorted canonical-first, always including the fallback; returns only the fallback when the catalog is unavailable.
unitEntryMatchesDimension matches a catalog entry to a dimension directly or via equivalentUnitDimensions.
equivalentUnitDimensions maps stress to pressure, displacement to length, rotation to angle, linear_stiffness to force_per_length, and volume_per_length to area.
unitCatalogStatus(route) reports the DEC-018 catalog loading state, the browser-preview no-fallback note, or the catalog decision basis, entry count, and storage convention.
editorFieldOptions(model, selection) returns the editable field list per entity type: material, node, pipe segment, support, component, load case, or combination.
Material editable fields include elastic_modulus and shear_modulus as stress quantities and thermal_expansion_coefficient, each with editable units.
Node editable fields are position.x/y/z as length quantities (default unit from project units length) plus label and provenance.
Pipe editable fields are section.outside_diameter and section.wall_thickness as length quantities, plus material reference and provenance.
scalarField(...) builds a non-unit-editable EditableField; quantityField(...) builds a unit-bearing EditableField with sourceNote 'unit metadata required'.

buildOperationIntent(field, model, proposedValue, proposedUnit, rationale, selection) builds an EditorOperationIntent of kind modify; for unit-editable fields the after value is a JSON {value, unit} payload.

Edit intent validation starts not_run/not_generated/not_applied; audit_boundary sets mutation_route=structured_operations_only, direct_model_mutation_allowed=false, requires_user_acceptance=true, mutates_accepted_model_state=false.
parseQuantityPayloadValue(raw) returns TBD for empty input, the numeric value when finite, otherwise the trimmed string.

buildCreateSectionIntent(draft, model) builds a create_section EditorOperationIntent with outside_diameter and wall_thickness quantities in the draft length unit; rationale requires service validation before durable model change.
buildCreateMaterialIntent(draft, model) builds a create_material intent with elastic_modulus and shear_modulus in the stress unit and optional thermal_expansion_coefficient; entered units preserved.
buildCreateSupportIntent(draft, model) builds a create_support intent capturing explicit user-entered support node and restraint tokens.
buildDeleteSupportIntent builds a delete_support intent requiring reference integrity validation before a durable model change.
buildDeleteNodeIntent builds a delete_node intent recording the node label and position, requiring endpoint and load reference integrity.
buildDeletePipeIntent builds a delete_pipe_run intent recording the pipe label, endpoints, and material, requiring primitive-load reference integrity.

matchingInlineValidationOutcome matches a validation outcome to an intent by operation_id, change_id, target ref/type, and change_kind, and validates the diff preview rows correspond to the intended change.
defaultSectionDraft/defaultMaterialDraft/defaultSupportDraft build creation drafts with the next reserved entity id, default units from the model, and provenance user_entered_local_preview.
nextSupportId/nextMaterialId/nextSectionId scan existing entities and queued create intents to find the next unreserved id (support:S-N, material:M-N, section:S-N).
isSectionDraftValid requires non-empty id/name/provenance, sectionType=pipe, a defined length unit, positive OD and wall thickness with wall < OD/2, and a unique section id.
isMaterialDraftValid requires non-empty id/label/provenance, a defined stress unit, positive elastic and shear moduli, valid thermal expansion when provided, and a unique material id.
isSupportDraftValid requires non-empty id/label/node/provenance, an existing target node, at least one valid restraint from RESTRAINT_OPTIONS, and a unique support id.
stressUnit(model) derives the stress unit from project units.pressure; thermalExpansionUnit derives 1/temperature; both fall back to TBD.
isPositiveInput(value) is true when the value is finite and greater than zero; isFiniteInput requires a non-empty finite number.
defaultSelection(model) returns a project EntityRef pointing at the model project id.
entityLabel(model, id) resolves the display label for any entity id across materials, sections, nodes, pipe segments, supports, components, load cases, and combinations, falling back to the id.
selectedProperties(model, selection) returns the label/value property pairs to display for the selected entity, dispatched by selection type.
Project properties are Project ID, Schema version, Mechanics status, Rule check status, and Professional acceptance status.
Material properties are ID, Elastic modulus, Shear modulus, Thermal expansion (or TBD), and Provenance, each formatted with value and unit.
Pipe properties are ID, From/To nodes, OD, Wall thickness, Material, and Provenance.
Load case properties are ID, Kind, Status, Load records count, primitive load Categories, Targets, and Provenance.
quantityDisplay formats a {value, unit} quantity or returns TBD; provenanceDisplay returns string provenance or JSON for objects.
primitiveLoadCategories and primitiveLoadTargets summarize a load case's primitive loads; formatPrimitiveLoadTarget renders type:node or type:pipe, defaulting to target:TBD.
stringField/optionalStringField safely read string record fields, returning TBD or null for missing/blank values.
NativePackagePanel Props include analysisRun, editorIntents, model, modelHash, projectSummary, proposal, result, selectedReviewTarget, and storageCapability.
Type UnitPreservationWitness records a source/target ref and quantity pair with conversion_performed=false and preservation_status=unit_and_value_preserved.
NativePackagePanel renders the native JSON package review when result and analysisRun exist, computes a package hash via usePackageHash, and exposes an Export JSON download link.

When no packet exists, the panel prompts running the mechanics preview to assemble a native JSON package review manifest with stable IDs, loss report, validation report, and local-only export boundaries.
buildNativePackageReview(...) assembles the native JSON package review document from entity refs, result refs, operation refs, diagnostics, and unit preservation evidence.

The package manifest member inventory lists deterministic-path members: manifest.json, model/project.json, maps/stable_id_map.json, reports/loss_report.json, reports/validation_report.json, diagnostics, runs, results, unit witnesses, and pending operations.
The native package document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.native_json_package_review with deliverable and package refs (DEL-17-02/03, etc.) and export_scope local_browser_download_preview.

export_profile native_open_json_preview preserves explicit units, requires a unit-witness sidecar for native JSON quantity fields, preserves source coordinates, uses a sidecar stable ID map, and mandates the loss report; physical container and public transport remain TBD.

The manifest declares deterministic_hash_basis JCS-compatible JSON, excludes runtime timestamps from hash inputs, and notes no protected standards, private rule payload, or release/compliance/acceptance claim is bundled.
loss_report uses categories exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, and tbd; target-specific adapter behavior is unsupported and physical container / transport protocol are tbd.
validation_report covers package shape, deterministic member paths/ordering, model hash status, protected-content and private-payload screening, and asserts release_or_professional_claim=false.
generation_context records the local storage engine, network/daemon/telemetry flags, persisted review-context counts, repository_default_private_write=false, and runtime_timestamp_omitted=true.
buildUnitPreservationEvidence(model, result) collects model and result quantity witnesses preserving each quantity's value and unit without conversion.
Model unit witnesses are emitted for material elastic_modulus, shear_modulus, optional thermal_expansion_coefficient, pipe section quantities, and load-case primitive-load magnitudes.
Result unit witnesses are emitted for summary max_displacement and max_open_formula_stress and for each result row value/unit.

Unit preservation declares unit_system_ref unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display, preservation_policy that native open JSON preserves source quantity value and unit fields, and conversion_performed=false.

unitPreservationWitness(...) builds a witness with identical rounded source and target quantities, conversion_performed=false, basis_refs DEC-018/DEL-02-02/DEL-17-03, and a browser-preview provenance note.
withPackageHash(packet, packageHash) augments the validation report with package_hash_status computed_local_preview_sha256 or a TBD when the canonical package hash service is unavailable.
modelEntityRefs(model) collects and sorts all entity ids (project, materials, nodes, pipe segments, supports, components, load cases, combinations).
operationReviewRefs collects sorted review-only refs from editor intent queue/operation ids plus the proposal operation id.
quantityRecord(value) returns a {value, unit} record only when value is a numeric value with a string unit, otherwise null.
runHashStatus returns the analysis-run hash ref count or a sha256:<value> for a given payload scope, TBD when not available.

nativePackageBoundary(packet) returns a local-review-only boundary statement only when no private payload, protected content, release/compatibility/compliance claim, or professional approval claim is present.
round(value) rounds a number to 6 decimal places for deterministic witness quantities.
OperationApplyPanel(queuedIntents, outcomes, appliedOperations, undoCount, redoCount, busy, message, engineStatus, onValidate, onApply, onUndo, onRedo) renders the apply-structured-operations panel.
Panel summary: applying validates through the structured-operation seam and replaces the session model document; saving the project stores it locally.
The panel provides session edit history Undo/Redo controls disabled when busy or counts are zero, with a summary noting local_session_only=true and saved_project_mutated=false.
Each queued intent row shows the operation id, target and change, and Validate / Apply buttons; Validate validates without applying, Apply validates and applies to the session model.
The applied-operations ledger lists each receipt's operation id, target/change, application route, acceptance basis, persistence status, professional_approval flag, and short model hash.

Panel note: applying a structured operation records a user-initiated local-session acceptance only; it is not professional approval, certification, sealing, authentication, or a code-compliance claim, and earlier solve results are cleared because they no longer describe the edited model.
OutcomeSummary renders an operation outcome's mode, application/schema/unit/before_state validation, application route, diff preview rows, and per-diagnostic findings.
intentKey(intent) returns the intent queue_id or operation_id; shortHash truncates long hash strings to 24 characters with an ellipsis.
OperationLedgerPanel React component renders an Operation Review Ledger from model, analysisRun, editorIntents, proposal, and selectedReviewTarget inputs.
The panel builds its ledger via buildOperationReviewLedger and only renders records when the ledger has at least one record.
When no operations are queued, the panel states GUI and agent changes must remain proposed operations until explicit user acceptance.
Operation ledger records are local review evidence only; the panel does not apply operations and never creates professional acceptance.
buildOperationReviewLedger assembles records from editor intents plus an optional agent proposal and tallies decision counts by status.
The operation review ledger document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.operation_review_ledger with export_scope local_browser_download_preview.

Ledger audit_posture asserts default user acceptance required, accepted records require explicit user signal, preview records do not apply operations, and rejected records do not mutate accepted state.

The ledger surfaces unresolved TBDs: durable operation audit persistence, final actor identity model, and durable applied-operation receipt persistence (session receipts only until the model-document persistence tranche).
editorIntentRecord builds a held audit record from a GUI editor operation intent sourced from the editor intent queue.
Editor intent validation_outcome is forced to status held_for_user_acceptance in the review ledger.
proposalRecord builds a held audit record from an agent proposal with record_source agent_proposal and actor_type agent.
Proposal record assumptions always include explicit user acceptance not recorded and operation application disabled in technical preview.
heldDecision returns status held_for_user_acceptance with explicit_user_acceptance false, acceptance_required true, and accepted_model_state_mutated false.
professionalBoundary asserts human_review_required true and all compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims false.
ledgerBoundary confirms review-only posture: requires explicit user acceptance, does not mutate accepted model state, no compliance or professional approval claim.
PcfPayloadSegment type fixes nominal_size to the literal TBD_SOURCE_REQUIRED, refusing to silently invent nominal pipe size.
PcfConversionWitness type records source quantity, target quantity in MM, conversion factor, and conversion status for auditable length conversions.
PcfExportPanel renders a Conservative PCF Export panel from model, mechanics result, and analysisRun, binding a canonical package hash.
PCF export is a conservative local review package only; unresolved target profile, nominal size, support, component, and translator-default behavior remain visible in diagnostics and loss reporting.
PCF export package document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.conservative_pcf_export_package (deliverable DEL-17-07, package PKG-17).
PCF export_profile ops.pcf.conservative_subset targets the pcf family with subset scope of invented straight pipe segments only.
PCF export profile enforces explicit units (no hidden defaults), project XYZ millimeter coordinates, and an authoritative sidecar ID map identity policy.
PCF export profile mandates a loss report for every package, blocks or loss-reports hidden translator defaults, and leaves supports unsupported or TBD until source-confirmed.
PCF package is not completeness, import-compatibility, solver-validation, code-compliance, release-readiness, or professional-reliance evidence.
pcfPayload converts node coordinates and pipe geometry to millimeters and emits conservative straight-pipe segments with TBD nominal size.
PCF payload declares bore, coordinate, bolt diameter, and bolt length units as MM and weight as KG with coordinate_basis project_xyz_millimeters.
PCF payload omits supports as omitted_entities and lists support restraint semantics and boundary-condition semantics as unsupported_entities.
PCF payload lists target profile version and each segment nominal size as tbd_entities.
conversionWitness records each length conversion to millimeters with decision_basis_refs DEC-018 and DEL-02-02.
expectedPcfConversionWitnessCount equals node count times three coordinate axes plus the number of present pipe-section outside-diameter and wall-thickness fields.
renderPcfText produces deterministic ASCII PCF text beginning with ISOGEN-FILES and STATUS FOR-REVIEW and terminated by END-ISOGEN.
PCF diagnostics raise a blocking PCF-COORDINATE-UNIT-TBD when the model length unit is not m or mm and thus not mapped to the millimeter coordinate policy.
PCF diagnostics raise a blocking PCF-NOMINAL-SIZE-TBD because preview pipe segments carry no source-owned nominal size required by the conservative profile.
PCF diagnostics warn PCF-SUPPORT-SEMANTICS-UNSUPPORTED that support and restraint semantics are not reliably preserved by the desktop PCF preview.
PCF diagnostics warn PCF-TARGET-PROFILE-TBD that the first supported PCF target profile/version remains TBD.
requiredLossCategoriesPresent verifies the loss report covers exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, and tbd categories.
convertLengthToMillimeters multiplies meters by 1000 (factor 1000) and leaves other units unchanged (factor 1), rounding to six decimals.
ProjectStorageAuditPanel renders a Project Storage Audit from model, storage capability, project summary, project index, and queued operations.
Model hash integrity line shows integrity_status, persisted vs recomputed values, and verification basis as a review-only integrity signal for human review.
Storage audit packets are local technical-preview evidence only; create/open/save operations do not accept model changes, copy external project files, or create professional reliance.
buildProjectStorageAuditPacket assembles a local project persistence audit from storage capability, project summary, project index, and pending operations.
Storage audit document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.local_project_persistence_audit with export_scope local_browser_download_preview.
Storage audit boundary asserts local_only_project_store true, repository_default_private_write false, accepted_model_state_mutated false, and no network, daemon, or telemetry requirement.
storageDiagnostics emits STORAGE-AUDIT-LOCAL-ONLY stating project storage is local technical-preview evidence and does not create professional acceptance.
Storage diagnostics emit STORAGE-FTS5-NOT-AVAILABLE info when the browser fallback storage is not FTS5 indexed.
RoundTripCategory type records a category, semantic_equality_status, checked_ref_count, and asserts no silent default, protected, or private payload expansion.
ProjectValidationPanel renders a Project Validation Preflight covering schema/version, migration, round-trip, and model/envelope hash evidence.
Validation preflight records version, migration, and round-trip review evidence for the local technical preview without applying queued operations or making professional reliance claims.
buildProjectValidationPacket assembles a project_validation_preflight packet with model-hash, envelope-hash, round-trip, store-migration, and model-document-migration evidence.
Version check status is supported_current_schema when model.schema_version equals 0.1.0, otherwise unsupported_schema_review_required.
Validation profile uses JSON Schema baseline 2020-12 and JCS-compatible canonicalization basis.
Project envelope hash scope is the persisted envelope payload excluding storage summary and hash carrier.
modelHashEvidenceStatus maps integrity status to verified_on_open, mismatch_review_required, recompute_unavailable, persisted-not-verified, computed-not-persisted, or service-unavailable.
buildRoundTripCategories declares semantic round-trip categories for model content, unit metadata, load payloads, rule-pack references, provenance, and reproducibility.
DEC-019 evidence: in-document semver is the version authority; migration runs in memory on open and persists on save with a ledger record.
modelDocumentMigrationEvidence builds DEC-019 migration evidence with version_authority in_document_schema_version_semver and asserts no destructive rewrite or down-migration.
buildStoreMigrationEvidence reports store schema migration framework/status and scopes migration to local store schema DDL only, with model document schema tracked separately per DEC-019.
unitMetadataPresent requires every project unit, pipe-section quantity, and material modulus to carry explicit unit metadata.
countUnitBearingRecords counts pipe-section, material modulus/expansion, and load magnitude quantities that carry a unit.
validationDiagnostics emits a blocking PROJECT-VALIDATION-UNSUPPORTED-SCHEMA when the schema version is not supported by the technical-preview preflight.
Canonical model hash is a local technical-preview review-reproducibility signal scoped to the model payload, not an acceptance, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance record.
Project-envelope hash is a review-reproducibility signal over the persisted envelope payload (storage summary and hash carrier excluded), not an acceptance or compliance record.
storeMigrationDiagnostic reports that store migrations applied on open are local store maintenance evidence only, not a model document migration or acceptance record.
ReportLintPanel renders a Report Content Lint summarizing scanned targets, findings, and blocking findings.
Lint output is deterministic technical-preview review evidence for public preview surfaces only; it is not legal clearance, redaction certification, or professional acceptance.
buildReportLintPacket scans public report surface targets for prohibited markers and claims and emits a deterministic lint run.
Report lint baseline is a deterministic public-surface heuristic linter; legal_clearance, security_sufficiency, and professional_approval are all false.
Lint run scans an explicit set of public surface roots and skips private surfaces unless explicitly authorized.
Lint finding order is path_line_column_code and synthetic markers must be invented, not protected examples.
Lint summary clean_scan_is_clearance is false: a clean scan is not clearance.
lintFindings matches each target text against protected-marker and prohibited-claim codes, emitting pending findings.
protectedMarkerCode flags synthetic PROTECTED_CONTENT, PRIVATE_DATA, and PROPRIETARY_SOURCE markers as BLOCKING IP/privacy boundary findings routed to human review.
prohibitedClaimCode flags text claiming software certifies, seals, approves, or is code-compliant for reliance as a BLOCKING PROHIBITED_PROFESSIONAL_CLAIM.
Public report surfaces must not claim certification, sealing, approval, authentication, or code compliance.
DEC-021 (A7): the Rust renderer crate composes, gates, and hashes the calculation report; this panel only requests a render and shows the canonical SHA-256 and gate state.
Save and print are refused while the renderer reports export_blocked; printed/PDF output is a derived view naming the canonical hash and is never hash-bound evidence.
RenderedReportPanel renders an FR-016 calculation report, exposing render, save canonical HTML, and print/PDF actions.
Report rendering is enabled only when both a mechanics result and an analysis run exist and no render is in progress.
When export is blocked the panel lists the blocking reasons instead of offering save; otherwise it offers a download of the canonical HTML named by the hash prefix.
The rendered report preview is shown in a sandboxed iframe; the derived print view is rendered to a hidden iframe that triggers print on load.
ReportPanel assembles a Report Packet from model, design knowledge, mechanics result, analysis run, comparison, editor intents, proposal, and persistence state.
Report panel uses invented or cleared preview data; private rule criteria and professional acceptance are not bundled.
reportDiagnostics aggregates model diagnostics, design-knowledge diagnostics, and mechanics-result diagnostics.
boundarySummary confirms human review required with no compliance, certification, sealing, or approval claim.
reportExportPacket builds an openpipestress.technical_preview.report_packet_export referencing many deliverables across the report and export tranches.
reportUnitSystemDisclosure binds the DEC-018 unit system reference and notes the report packet preserves entered and result units.
reportPersistenceEvidence assembles report_persistence_export_context with storage audit, validation preflight, and an export-readiness inventory.
Export readiness marks result envelope, stress-neutral, FEA handoff, native JSON, report packet, and handoff exports as pending until a mechanics run completes.
Report persistence boundary asserts local-only project store, repository_default_private_write false, accepted_model_state_mutated false, and no private/protected payload or release claim.
runAuditExport exports analysis-run audit fields: model state ref, run kind/status, result and hash counts, reproducibility input manifest refs, immutability policy, and professional boundary.
editorIntentBoundarySummary confirms review-only: requires user acceptance, no direct model mutation, does not mutate accepted state, no compliance or approval claim.
DEC-021 (A7): the frontend composes only references, disclosures, and display rows; the Rust renderer crate owns document composition, gating, and hashing.
Every renderer-input value is copied from session envelopes, computed locally with canonical-JSON/sha256 discipline, or an explicit visible TBD marker.
KNOWN_ANALYSIS_STATUSES enumerates MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, and HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

SECTION_KINDS lists the eight report section kinds: model input summary, load cases, results, warnings/assumptions/provenance, audit manifest, rule-pack references, limitations, and professional boundary notice.
PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY constant asserts human_review_required true and all compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims false.
DEC018_UNIT_SYSTEM_REF identifies the unit system unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display.
buildUnitDisplaySummary preserves entered units, sorts model and result units, and sets conversion_performed false (no report-time conversion).
buildRenderableReportInput assembles the renderer input document from session state, computing canonical SHA-256 hashes of the model and report sections.
Analysis status disclosures always append HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, requiring human professional review before any reliance on the report.
The report carries a technical-preview limitation: output over invented or user-local data is not validated engineering output and requires human review.
Report checksums use sha256 with rfc8785_jcs canonicalization, defaulting missing values to the literal TBD.
DEC-021 (A7) coverage: the rendered-report seam routes through the Tauri renderer command only, with no fallback renderer in browser preview.
The rendered-report adapter composes the renderer input from session envelopes with explicit TBD markers.
The rendered-report panel refuses save and print while export is blocked.
The renderedReport test mocks @tauri-apps/api/core invoke to assert routing without a real Tauri runtime.
reportRenderService reports an explicit desktop-only route 'unavailable_browser_preview' in browser preview without invoking the backend.
In browser preview the render-service diagnostic contains REPORT-RENDERER-DESKTOP-ONLY.
In the Tauri runtime renderCalculationReport invokes the 'render_calculation_report' command and resolves route 'tauri_renderer'.
buildRenderableReportInput maps session envelopes into the renderer input with explicit TBD markers.
The renderable report_id is derived from the run id as 'report:run:<run_id>'.
When no saved project exists the model_input_summary persistence_ref.ref_id is 'TBD'.
The renderable report unit_system_ref is 'unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display'.
The report unit_display_summary preserves entered units with storage_convention 'entered_units_preserved' and no report-time conversion (conversion_performed false).
The renderable report defines 8 template_slots and 8 rendered_sections.
Each result row maps to row_id 'row:<result_id>', a label from family, a case_ref, a quantity_display '<value> <unit>', and a source_ref.
When a project summary exists the persistence_ref.ref_id becomes 'local_sqlite:project:<id>'.
RenderedReportPanel requires a solved mechanics result before rendering; the render control is disabled and a precondition notice is shown.
An unblocked render shows the canonical hash and offers save/print actions; the saved file is named 'openpipestress-report-<hash12>.html'.
While export is blocked the panel surfaces 'EXPORT BLOCKED', lists blocking reasons (e.g. ProhibitedProfessionalClaim), and hides the save and print actions.
In browser preview the rendered-report panel surfaces the explicit REPORT-RENDERER-DESKTOP-ONLY diagnostic and does not invoke the backend.
ResultExportPanel builds a result-export packet only when both a mechanics result and an analysis run are present.
The result-export download is a local JSON file named 'openpipestress-preview-results-<token>.json'.
When no result is available the panel prompts to run a mechanics preview to assemble a schema-first local result envelope for review and regression use.
Result export is a local technical-preview JSON envelope; stress-neutral CSV/JSON preview is available after a mechanics run, while public transport and local FEA package formats remain TBD.
The result-export packet sorts result values by id (localeCompare) for deterministic ordering.

The export_format_status baseline_format is schema_first_json_result_envelope with stress_neutral_csv_json_preview available; public transport protocol, local FEA package format, and external adapter formats are TBD.
The result envelope id is 'result-envelope:<run_id>'.
The solver_version names 'OpenPipeStress product_physics technical preview' version 0.1.0 with build ref local_fixture_preview.
Reproducibility records a model_hash with algorithm/canonicalization/value all TBD, run_hashes from run hashes, an audit_manifest_ref, and deterministic_ordering true.
The exported rule_pack_ref marks a user-supplied pack not loaded, with completeness_status missing_required_inputs and private_payload_redacted true.
Downstream use of the result envelope permits review, regression comparison, report consumption, headless automation, and governed downstream tooling.
quantityResult omits the metadata field when item metadata is absent and the family is neither force nor moment.
resultMetadata defaults component, coordinate_system, and basis to TBD, location to 'summary', and sign_convention to a preview-not-expanded note when not provided.
resultExportDiagnostic maps severity 'error' to 'blocking' and otherwise preserves the source severity.

diagnosticClass classifies a diagnostic by code substring: RULE -> RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE -> PROVENANCE_WARNING, UNIT -> UNIT_WARNING, blocking/error -> EXPORT_BLOCKING, else ASSUMPTION_WARNING.
resultFamily classifies a result by kind or id substring into displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, or ratio (default ratio).
resultDimension maps family to dimension: displacement->length, reaction/force->force, moment->moment, stress->stress, ratio->dimensionless, rotation kind->angle, else TBD.
boundarySummary asserts 'human review required; no compliance, certification, sealing, authentication, or approval claim' only when human_review_required and no professional-claim flags are set.
jsonDataHref encodes a payload as a data:application/json URI for local download.
The Results panel offers result page sizes of 50, 100, and 200, defaulting to 50.
Result families are displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, ratio, and other.
ResultsPanel filters, paginates, and groups mechanics result rows and builds a result interpretation for the selected row.
Result rows are grouped by family into tables showing ID, Entity, Location, and Value columns.
When no rows match the filter the panel shows 'No computed preview result rows match this filter.'
When no result is present the panel prompts to run the bounded preview mechanics path to populate result summaries.
ResultDetail prompts to select a computed result row to inspect recovery context and review boundary when none is selected.
An endpoint-pair table is shown for results that have a paired end-i/end-j endpoint, listing Location, Result, and Value.
The Mechanics Gap Ledger surfaces capability, status, and review note for each preview mechanics gap.
paginateResults clamps the page index into range and computes 1-based start, end, page index, and page count.
filterResults matches a lowercased query across id, kind, entity_ref, unit, value, basis ref, metadata fields, and source_result_refs.
resultFamilyKey classifies a result into displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, ratio, or 'other' by kind/id substring.
buildResultInterpretation returns null when the selected result id is not found in the result rows.
Result interpretation links diagnostics whose affected_refs include the result id or its entity_ref.
Result interpretation counts result-value hashes from the analysis run's matching result_ref hash_refs.
Envelope hash availability is true when an analysis-run hash has payload_scope 'result_envelope'.
Interpretation defaults coordinate_system to 'result_envelope', location to 'summary', and sign_convention to 'not specified in result metadata' when absent.
Result interpretation professional_boundary is 'human review required; review-only interpretation; no compliance or professional approval claim'.
buildDiagnosticInterpretation links results and knowledge to a diagnostic by affected_refs and returns null when the diagnostic is not found.
Diagnostic interpretation professional_boundary is 'review-only diagnostic explanation; no compliance or professional approval claim'.
resolveEntitySelection resolves an entity ref to a node, pipe, support, component, or load case by matching model collections.
resolveDiagnosticEntitySelection resolves a diagnostic's affected_refs to a model entity directly or via the referenced result's entity_ref.
mechanicsGaps enumerates preview mechanics capability gaps with id, capability, status, and review_note.
Endpoint-j local force/moment recovery is implemented: end-i and end-j local force/moment preview results are emitted and paired; arbitrary station sweeps remain deferred.
Endpoint stress component recovery is implemented: end-i and end-j open-mechanics stress component preview results are emitted and paired when stress recovery succeeds.

Intermediate station recovery emits fixed station-grid force, moment, shear-force, and stress rows from interpolated endpoint resultants; arbitrary sweeps, exact internal diagrams, and shear-stress recovery remain deferred.
Pressure-to-frame load conversion applies closed-end pressure thrust for straight preview pipes to frame resultants; broader pressure behavior remains deferred.

Thermal behavior implements uniform axial temperature-change loads for straight preview pipes with explicit material expansion input; temperature-dependent properties and thermal combinations remain deferred.
Support stiffness completeness is deferred: linear support restraints are preview inputs, and richer or nonlinear stiffness requires explicit data.
Load combinations are implemented for explicit mechanics-basis user combinations from matching scalar load-case rows; code/rule combinations remain deferred or private.
Protected rule/code checks require private inputs: private criteria, allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, and code checks are not bundled publicly.
endpointPairFor pairs end-i/end-j results only for force, moment, or stress families matching entity_ref, component, coordinate system, and basis, requiring at least two values.
resultInterpretation resultFamily defaults to 'TBD' when no family substring matches (contrast with ResultsPanel default 'ratio'/'other').
A StableIdMapEntry carries stable_id, canonical_family, export_status (emitted|approximated|metadata_only|omitted), gltf_ref, and review_note.
A CoordinateUnitWitness records source and target refs, source/target quantities, conversion_performed false, and an axis_transform mapping preview Z-up to glTF Y-up.
The review-geometry export downloads a glTF JSON file named 'openpipestress-preview-review-geometry-<token>.gltf.json'.
Review geometry is visual context only; it is not solver geometry, target compatibility evidence, or professional validation.
The review-geometry packet document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.review_geometry_export with review_geometry_status visual_review_geometry_only.
The review-geometry profile targets glTF 2.0 JSON (target_artifact glTF_2_0_json_preview, extension .gltf.json) while the GLB binary writer status is TBD.
Review-geometry source coordinates treat the source vertical axis as +Z and target glTF right-handed +Y-up meters, with transform_policy preview_z_up_to_gltf_y_up_rotation_x_minus_90.
Review-geometry primitive topology: pipe_segments as LINES, nodes as POINTS, supports and components as approximated POINTS markers.

The review-geometry unit_system_disclosure references unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display, performs no unit conversion, applies the Z-up to Y-up axis transform, and preserves source model units as meter quantities.
Review-geometry coverage emits pipe_segments and nodes, approximates supports and components, and omits materials, load_cases, and combinations.
Review-geometry TBD families include bends as curved surfaces, equipment interfaces, annotations, and load-case visual overlays.
The review-geometry package includes glTF-json, id_map, loss_report, and coordinate_unit_witnesses members, each with hash_status TBD in browser preview.
buildGltfPositionGroups builds LINES centerline groups for pipe segments and POINTS marker groups for nodes, supports, and components, dropping empty groups.
buildCoordinateUnitWitnesses emits per-axis witnesses mapping source x/y/z to glTF x/z/y with y negated, preserving units while transforming axes.
buildGltfAsset packs all positions into a Float32 buffer with per-group bufferViews (target 34962) and VEC3 float accessors carrying min/max bounds.
The glTF buffer is embedded as a data:application/octet-stream;base64 URI in the JSON download.
stableIdEntries builds the sidecar ID map: project metadata_only, materials/load_cases/combinations omitted, nodes/pipe_segments emitted, supports/components approximated point markers.
reviewGeometryLossReport enumerates approximation/omission losses for centerline-only segments, point-marker supports/components, omitted loads/combinations, and TBD GLB/viewer behavior.
reviewGeometryDiagnostics emits REVIEW-GEOMETRY-UNITS-METERED (info) when length unit is meters or REVIEW-GEOMETRY-UNITS-TBD (blocking) otherwise, plus a REVIEW-GEOMETRY-VISUAL-ONLY warning.
gltfPosition transforms a source position (x,y,z) to glTF (x, z, -y).
round normalizes numeric coordinates to 6 decimal places.
professionalBoundary asserts human_review_required true and all solver-geometry-equivalence, target-compatibility, compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims false.
A rule-check WarningClass is one of RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, ASSUMPTION_WARNING, or IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING.

A CompletenessFinding carries finding_id, warning_class, severity, affected/source refs, message, remediation, and flags for private data, protected content, mechanics-solve blocking, and rule-check blocking.
The rule-check completeness export downloads a local JSON file named 'openpipestress-preview-rule-completeness-<token>.json'.

Completeness findings explain missing user/private rule-check data; mechanics preview output remains review-only and is not a compliance, approval, certification, sealing, or professional acceptance result.
The rule completeness review document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.rule_completeness_review with export_scope local_browser_download_preview.

The completeness summary reports finding_count, rule_check_blocked, blocking/warning counts, mechanics_results_reviewable, and false flags for silent defaults, bundled code values, and compliance claims.
buildFindings raises a RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING finding when rule_check status includes incomplete, missing, or not_performed.
The required-rule-inputs-missing finding states user-supplied rule-pack inputs are absent and the public preview does not bundle code defaults.
A PROVENANCE_WARNING is raised for components whose provenance indicates no flexibility factor / stress-intensification data, requiring user-supplied or privately imported correction data.
A RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING finding flags that load cases/combinations are mechanics-basis preview inputs, not code-specific rule combinations, requiring private owner/code criteria.
A PROVENANCE_WARNING flags material and pipe-section values as invented public fixture values, not verified project or catalog data.
An ASSUMPTION_WARNING is raised when professional acceptance is not_provided, requiring a human authority to record acceptance outside the software.
ruleBoundary summarizes 'private rule data absent; silent defaults used=false; bundled code values=false; no compliance claim'.
Phase C4 GUI slice (TP-C4-CHECKGUI-001): jsdom has no Tauri runtime, so browser-preview tests pin the honest desktop-only seam while the desktop-render test opts into the backend path.
The unit catalog stub is unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display with si_canonical calculation basis and entered_units_preserved storage, containing pascal, kilopascal, megapascal, and ratio entries.
The unit catalog boundary asserts no protected content, no private project data, no professional approval, and no code-compliance claim.
RuleCheckRunPanel surfaces project scope and a no-solve reason ('create or open a local project first'; 'No solved mechanics result') honestly.
RuleCheckRunPanel disables Run until a rule pack is loaded.
Loading the bundled demo pack derives binding controls: solver-result inputs become result-row selects and user value/slot inputs become entry fields.
In desktop mode the panel loads the DEC-018 unit catalog via get_unit_catalog and offers runtime value units (e.g. MPa) as a SELECT.
An invalid pasted rule pack reports RULE-CHECK-PACK-JSON-INVALID and keeps Run disabled.
A private_library_value input surfaces a private library reference (material:lib:steel, slot allow:Sh) that is never embedded in the rule pack.
An authored solver_result_ref is surfaced as canonical, supersedes the run-panel selector, and previews a resolving result row at run time.
A missing authored solver_result_ref is reported as result_missing (RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE) without inventing a fallback binding.
In browser preview running rule checks reports the desktop-only seam RULE-CHECK-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY and shows no run result.
A desktop rule-check run renders per-check outcomes and the aggregate, surfacing computed value, the acceptability relation (TP-C4-ACCEPTREL-001), and the not-a-professional-claim boundary.
When a solver_result_ref is authored in the pack, caller-supplied solver bindings are omitted from the run_rule_checks invocation.
Phase C4 app-held envelope wiring (TP-C4-APPAGG-001): the panel lifts the worst-of rule-check aggregate to the app via onAggregateChange.
On a desktop run the panel lifts the worst-of aggregate (e.g. USER_RULE_FAILED) to onAggregateChange.
The lifted aggregate is cleared (null) when a new pack is loaded and on the desktop-only browser seam.

Phase C3 resolution-preview/browse picker (TP-C3-LIBREFPICKER-001): a Preview resolution action queries the local store (desktop-only) and reports whether a library reference resolves without mutating the pack.
A resolving library reference previews and browses local records/slots via list_local_libraries and open_local_library, marking referenced records/slots.
A library reference pointing nowhere reports library_missing and short-circuits before open_local_library.
The preview distinguishes record_missing from slot_missing against the stored library and notes it blocks at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
In browser preview a library reference preview reports status unavailable with LIBRARY-IMPORT-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY.
RuleCheckRunPanel implements the 'Run Rule Checks' GUI (PRD §22.4/§14.5, completion plan C4 GUI slice TP-C4-CHECKGUI-001) making the R3 exit criterion GUI-true.

The C4 backend (run_rule_checks command + core/rules/rule_check_runner) is engine-true; this panel surfaces per-check USER_RULE_CHECKED / USER_RULE_FAILED / RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE plus the worst-of aggregate.
Pass/fail is BLOCKED on missing inputs; the run is desktop-only and the service reports an explicit unavailable route in browser preview.
No professional, certification, sealing, approval, or code-compliance claim is made anywhere in the rule-check panel.
NO_PACK_REASON: no rule-pack document loaded; load the demo, open a saved pack, or paste a pack.
NO_SOLVE_REASON: no solved mechanics result in the session, so solver_result inputs cannot bind to result rows; run a solve first.
NO_PROJECT_REASON: saved rule packs are project-scoped; a local project must be created or opened first.
BUSY_REASON: a rule-check backend request is in progress; the user must wait for it to finish.
parsePack(text) trims input, returns null when empty, and parses JSON; it rejects non-object/array/null with 'The rule-pack document must be a JSON object.'
unitOptions(route, dimensionId, currentSymbol) builds the selectable unit options for a dimension, falling back to the current unit basis when not on the tauri_unit_catalog route.
Accepted catalog units are filtered to the binding's dimension, sorted canonical-first then by symbol, and the fallback basis is prepended if absent.
UnitBindingControl renders a catalog-backed <select> on the tauri_unit_catalog route, otherwise a free-text input, and always shows the unit-basis label.
Library reference resolution preview (Phase C3, TP-C3-LIBREFPICKER-001): a private_library_value input's library_value_ref is authored in the pack and resolved backend-side at run time.

The library preview is read-only with respect to the pack: it queries the local store to show whether the authored reference resolves and lets the user browse records/slots, never mutating or overriding the pack reference and never rendering the private value.
LIBRARY_KINDS for reference resolution are material, section, and component.
LIBRARY_RESOLUTION_LABEL maps each resolution to user text: resolves, record_missing, slot_missing, library_missing.
renderLibraryPreview renders the preview state: unavailable diagnostic, error message, unsupported-kind note, or the browsable resolution status with available libraries and records/slots.

When a library reference resolves, the private value is read at run time and never embedded in the rule pack; otherwise the check blocks at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE until the reference points at a present record/slot.
Solver-result reference resolution preview (Phase C4, TP-C4-SOLVERREFPICKER-001): a solver_result input may carry an authored solver_result_ref (DEC-039).
The authored in-pack solver_result_ref is canonical and supersedes the run-panel selector; the preview is read-only and never invents a fallback binding.
SOLVER_RESULT_RESOLUTION_LABEL maps each resolution to user text: resolves, result_missing, no_result_rows.
renderSolverPreview shows whether the authored result_id resolves in the current solved envelope and lists up to 12 available result rows for discovery.
RuleCheckRunPanel takes model, result, optional onAggregateChange, and optional onR3JourneyEvent props.

onAggregateChange lifts the worst-of rule-check aggregate to the app to wire into the app-held analysis-run envelope (TP-C4-APPAGG-001), called with the aggregate on success or null when there is no current run outcome.
projectId is derived from model.project.id; the parsed pack and the derived RuleCheckBindingPlan are memoized over the pack text.
hasRuntimeUnitBindings is true when the plan has value inputs or value slots, gating whether the unit catalog must be loaded.
An effect loads the DEC-018 unit catalog when runtime unit bindings exist, setting an unavailable_browser_preview route with a diagnostic on failure, and cancels on unmount.
resetForNewPack(text) clears solver selections, value bindings, run result, and library/solver previews, and invalidates the app-held aggregate via onAggregateChange(null).

handlePreviewLibrary previews whether an input's authored library_value_ref resolves in the local store and captures available libraries/records/slots; read-only, never mutating the pack or run binding.
A library_kind not in material/section/component yields a note that the reference cannot resolve at run time.
handlePreviewLibrary lists local libraries, finds the matching kind+library_id, opens it, indexes records/slots, and classifies the reference; browser-preview routes surface their diagnostic.
bindingUnit(refId, fallback) returns the user-bound unit for a ref or the fallback unit.
handlePreviewSolver classifies the input's solver_result_ref result_id against the current solved result rows.

handleLoadDemo loads the bundled invented demonstration rule pack, resets state, fires the rule_check_pack_loaded journey event, and labels it an invented non-engineering example, not an engineering design basis.
handleRefreshList lists saved rule packs for the current project (or across all local projects), handling the unavailable_browser_preview route.
handleOpen loads a saved rule pack envelope for run, resets state, and fires the rule_check_pack_loaded journey event.
buildSolverBindings maps solver inputs without an authored solver_result_ref to {input_id, result_id} selectors, dropping empty selections.
buildSuppliedBindings collects supplied value bindings from value inputs and value slots, parsing the value to a finite number and attaching unit and dimension.
handleRun calls runRuleChecks with the pack document, model, solved envelope, solver-result bindings, supplied value bindings, and projectId; it blocks when no valid pack/plan exists.
On a successful run, handleRun sets the run result, lifts the worst-of aggregate via onAggregateChange (TP-C4-APPAGG-001), and reports check count, aggregate, and grammar version.
handleRun fires the rule_check_run_requested journey event before invoking the backend.
The Run button is disabled when the pack does not parse or a request is in flight; the disabled reason is NO_PACK_REASON or BUSY_REASON.
Unbound or missing inputs block the check at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE; pass/fail is never reported on missing inputs.
On the tauri_unit_catalog route the DEC-018 unit catalog backs run-check value bindings; browser preview keeps run-check unit refs as stored manual text with no fallback catalog synthesized.
An authored solver_result_ref result_id resolves from the current solved result envelope at run time, supersedes the run-panel selector, and is removed in the editor to return to manual binding.
A private_library_value input resolves from library_kind:library_id → record → slot at run time on desktop; the value stays in the library and is never embedded in the rule pack.

Boundary note: rule checks run locally over user-supplied data only; the software emits user-defined check statuses and never a code-compliance, certification, sealing, approval, authentication, or professional acceptance claim. Human review remains required.
aggregateLabel maps USER_RULE_CHECKED to '(pass)', USER_RULE_FAILED to '(fail)', and RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE to '(blocked on missing inputs)'.

CheckDefinitionsEditor (Phase C2 slice 5, TP-C2-CHECKDEF-001) implements PRD §14.5's requirement to let a user author the rule pack's acceptability checks.

check_definitions — binding declared required_inputs/value_slots and a formula into a check — was the last document-structure member previously hand-edited as raw JSON; this component replaces that with structured form controls.
Boundary: purely structured form controls with no writable expression text syntax (D-02b AWAITING_RULING); a check binds references and selects closed-vocabulary tokens, never expression text.

The software authors the check's shape only; it never decides pass/fail acceptance (the engine independently blocks incomplete checks — C4) and never fills in a code or standards value. Editing is lossless.
Editable enum vocabularies are copied verbatim from rule_pack.schema.yaml so controls emit only schema-valid tokens, and exported so a schema-conformance test can assert set equality.
ACCEPTABILITY_BASES = user_supplied_rule_pack, owner_design_basis, private_project_basis, invented_non_engineering_example, TBD.
ACCEPTABILITY_RELATIONS is the four ordering relations only (equality acceptance is a deliberate schema non-goal), mapping to the frozen grammar's comparison operators (DEC-022).
The runner defaults an absent acceptability relation to less_than_or_equal, so the editor authors it explicitly and never relies on a silent default.
ANALYSIS_STATUSES = MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES enumerates the ten rule diagnostic codes including RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, RULE_INPUT_MISSING, RULE_UNIT_MISMATCH, and RULE_PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_NOTICE.
DIAGNOSTIC_POLICY_FIELDS are the eight DiagnosticPolicy fields in schema order, each mapping a rule-check condition to its emitted diagnostic code.
readCheckIds returns the declared check_id values in document order, empty when none or malformed.
readFormulaDeclarationIds returns the declared formula_id values in document order, empty when none or malformed.
defaultDiagnosticPolicy returns a schema-valid DiagnosticPolicy with all eight condition→code bindings, byte-identical to the draft template's policy.

defaultCheckDefinition returns a schema-valid CheckDefinition with a fresh unique id, single-ref arrays bound to the first declared ids (or the 'TBD' placeholder), user-rule basis/statuses, default policy, and placeholder provenance; no numeric, code, or standards content is invented.
setCheckDefinitions returns a new document with the check_definitions array replaced.

updateFormulaRef sets the formula_ref ref_id while preserving its existing members.
updateDiagnosticPolicy sets one diagnostic-policy field's code while preserving the rest.
toggleResultStatus appends a status when toggled on and removes it when toggled off, refusing to drop below the minItems:1 schema floor.
Removing a check is blocked when only one remains: a rule pack needs at least one check definition.

DeclarationsEditor is the rule-pack declarations editor (Phase C2 slice 4, TP-C2-DECLEDITOR-001) providing structured form controls for declaring a rule pack's inputs and value slots.
PRD §14.5 requires the rule-pack editor to let a user declare the rule pack's inputs and user-supplied value slots — the named variables a formula's variable_ref binds to.
The declarations editor boundary is purely structured form controls with no writable expression text syntax (D-02b AWAITING_RULING).

The unknown-dimension and unknown-slot-kind placeholder is the uppercase "TBD" token the codec and schema accept (CONTRACT no-silent-defaults); placeholders are private-by-default with no silent defaults.

A patched declaration entry keeps every member it already carried (provenance, const-true relaxation flags, missing-value diagnostic) and untouched sibling entries round-trip verbatim — lossless editing.

UserSuppliedValueSlot carries a dimension/unit intent and a value_status, not a number; the actual private allowable value is not an authored member of this schema version, so the honest value_status marker is exposed instead of inventing a value field.

A required input whose source_kind is private_library_value additionally authors a library_value_ref (library_kind / library_id / record_id / slot_id) — the pointer the C4 rule-check runner resolves from the local private-library store at run time (TP-C3-LIBREFAUTHOR-001).
The library reference is carried but the private value is NEVER embedded in the rule-pack document (IP boundary, PRD §13/§17.3), so authoring a reference never redistributes a private value.

A required input whose source_kind is solver_result additionally authors a solver_result_ref (a single result_id) — the pointer the C4 rule-check runner resolves from the solved result envelope's results[] by id at run time (TP-C4-SOLVERREFAUTHOR-001).

The solver_result_ref is the in-pack canonical form of the previously caller-supplied {input_id, result_id} solver binding (PRD §12.5); an authored reference governs its input alone and supersedes the run panel's per-input result selector.
An unfilled or unresolvable reference leaves the input unsupplied so the check blocks at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE — never a silent pass.
library_value_ref (DEC-038) and solver_result_ref (DEC-039) are ratified schema members, carried at rule-pack schema_version 0.4.0.

Declaration quantity_intent unit refs use the reviewed DEC-018 catalog when the desktop backend exposes it; browser preview and backend-unavailable routes keep prior text input rather than synthesizing unit options (TP-UNITS-B2-RULEPACKUNITS-001).
The unit picker filters catalog entries by the selected dimension, keeps any stored out-of-catalog value visible as the current value, and never silently rewrites a dimension/unit pair.

SOURCE_KINDS enum vocabulary: solver_result, model_input, user_supplied_rule_value, private_library_value, owner_design_basis, TBD — copied verbatim from rule_pack.schema.yaml so controls only emit schema-valid tokens.
REQUIRED_FOR_TARGETS enum vocabulary: rule_check, reporting, diagnostic, TBD.
COMPLETENESS_STATUSES enum vocabulary: complete, missing_required_value, missing_unit, missing_provenance, missing_redistribution_status, review_pending, TBD.
SLOT_KINDS enum vocabulary: allowable, stress_limit, ratio_limit, coefficient, category_threshold, source_reference, TBD.
VALUE_STATUSES enum vocabulary: not_provided, private_user_supplied, public_permissive_reviewed, invented_non_engineering_example, protected_suspected, TBD.

LIBRARY_KINDS vocabulary is material, section, component — copied verbatim from rule_pack.schema.yaml; it has NO TBD member, so a seeded reference defaults library_kind to the first kind and leaves the ids as visible TBD placeholders.
uniqueDeclarationId(prefix, existingIds) generates a unique declaration id of the form <prefix>_<n>, skipping any id already present, matching the schema Id pattern.
readRequiredInputIds(document) returns the declared input_ids in document order (empty when none or malformed).
readValueSlotIds(document) returns the declared slot_ids in document order (empty when none or malformed).

defaultRequiredInput(existingIds) returns a schema-valid private placeholder RequiredInput with a fresh unique id, uppercase TBD dimension placeholder, const-true relaxation flags emitted true, and no invented value.

A default required input is seeded with source_kind user_supplied_rule_value, required_for rule_check, completeness_status missing_required_value, missing_value_diagnostic RULE_INPUT_MISSING, and redistribution_status private_only.
defaultValueSlot(existingIds) returns a schema-valid private placeholder UserSuppliedValueSlot with a fresh unique id, TBD slot kind/dimension, and not_provided value status (no value invented).

defaultLibraryValueRef() returns a schema-valid LibraryValueRef with all four members: library_kind defaulting to the first kind (material), and library_id/record_id/slot_id as visible uppercase TBD placeholders so an unfilled reference resolves to nothing and the input blocks.

defaultSolverResultRef() returns a schema-shaped SolverResultRef carrying the single required result_id member as the visible uppercase TBD placeholder; an unfilled reference matches no result row so the input blocks (never a silent pass).
setRequiredInputs(document, inputs) returns a new document with the required_inputs array replaced.
setValueSlots(document, slots) returns a new document with the value_slots array replaced.
hasTauriInternals() returns whether window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__ is present, used to detect the desktop runtime versus browser preview.

unitOptions(route, dimensionId, currentSymbol) builds the unit option list filtered by dimension from the tauri_unit_catalog route, sorting canonical units first, and prepends the current/fallback symbol when absent.

UnitRefField preserves the previous free-text behavior until the desktop catalog is available so browser preview does not invent a fallback catalog; with the catalog it renders a dimension-filtered select.
EnumSelect surfaces a stored token outside the current vocabulary as a "(current)" option rather than silently snapping it to a default, so the user sees exactly what is stored.
DeclarationsEditor patches one required input by index while untouched entries round-trip verbatim (updateInput).

changeInputSourceKind: switching to private_library_value seeds a placeholder library_value_ref when none exists, and switching to solver_result seeds a placeholder solver_result_ref, so the sub-form opens with a complete schema-valid (unresolved, blocking) reference.

Switching a required input's source_kind away from a reference kind leaves any existing reference in place (lossless); its sub-form stays visible so a now-meaningless reference is never silently hidden, and an explicit Remove control lets the user drop it.

updateInputLibraryRef merges a patch into the existing library_value_ref (or a fresh default when none exists) so the first field edit always produces a complete four-member reference, never a schema-invalid partial.
removeInputLibraryRef drops the library_value_ref member entirely — the only member-removing edit the editor exposes — while every other member of the input round-trips verbatim.
removeInputSolverRef drops the solver_result_ref member entirely, returning the input to the run-panel caller-supplied binding path, with every other member round-tripping verbatim.
Removing a required input is blocked when only one remains, with the stated reason "A rule pack needs at least one required input."
Removing a value slot is blocked when only one remains, with the stated reason "A rule pack needs at least one value slot."

The private-library reference sub-form is shown whenever the input draws from a private library OR whenever a reference is already present, so a reference left over from a since-changed source_kind stays visible and removable rather than silently hidden.
The referenced private-library value is resolved at check-run time from the local private library store; it stays in the library and is never embedded in the rule pack.

A solver-result reference binds the input to a specific row of the solved result envelope by result id, resolved at check-run time; an authored reference is the canonical binding that supersedes the run panel's per-input result selector.

ExpressionComposer.test.tsx (TP-C2-COMPOSER-001) tests the structured AST expression composer; pure-helper tests pin grammar v1.0.0 node encoding and the lossless document rewrite, component tests drive visible controls.
collectRulePackVariables collects declared required-input and value-slot variables, yielding ids user_required_input_1 (required_input) and user_limit_slot_1 (value_slot) for the draft document.

The schema's ExpressionQuantity is additionalProperties:false and allows only value/dimension/unit_ref; the unit_required/dimension_check_required relaxation flags are not authorable in pack documents (absent means true).
The unknown-dimension placeholder is the uppercase "TBD" token the codec (decode_quantity) and schema DimensionId accept — never lowercase "tbd".
defaultExpressionNode("literal") equals {node:literal, quantity:{value:0, dimension:TBD, unit_ref:TBD}}.
A default table node carries two strictly-increasing rows so interpolate is immediately well-formed, with TBD placeholders; a lookup node additionally carries an exact mode.

The dimension vocabulary offers only the codec/schema tokens with the uppercase TBD placeholder; a lowercase "tbd" default (the slice-2 regression) produced documents that fail backend decode and DimensionId schema validation.
Table nodes (interpolate, lookup) are editable as of slice 3; refusal markers and unknown tags remain non-editable and are preserved read-only.
setFormulaExpression rewrites one formula's expression AST while preserving the untouched sibling formula and the payload's other members (e.g. payload_kind).
parseRulePackDocument reports failure honestly: null text yields no-draft, invalid JSON and a top-level array are rejected, and a valid object yields {ok:true, document}.
renderExpressionText renders a read-only AST text preview without changing canonical AST shape, e.g. a compare/divide tree renders as "((stress_actual / 2 1 [dimensionless]) <= stress_limit)".
renderExpressionText renders unsafe_host_access as "[refusal:unsafe_host_access]" and an unrecognized node as "[unrecognized:future_feature]".
Adding a table row appends with strict monotonicity (last argument + 1); the last row cannot be removed because the schema requires at least one row.
Editing a table node's argument expression preserves the table metadata and rows verbatim — only the argument subtree changes.
An unrecognized node renders read-only with an honest explanation and survives intact when an editable sibling is edited (not dropped or rewritten).
Refusal-marker nodes (unsupported_form / unsafe_host_access) are always read-only, expose no node-type selector so they cannot be silently switched, and round-trip byte-for-byte.

ExpressionComposer is the structured AST expression composer (Phase C2 slice 2, TP-C2-COMPOSER-001), a recursive form/tree composer that builds the frozen grammar v1.0.0 typed AST (DEC-022) so a user never writes node-tagged JSON by hand.
PRD §14.5 requires the rule-pack editor to provide an Expression editor.

The composer boundary (D-02b RULED, DEC-037) is purely structured: it may show a labeled read-only one-way AST-to-text preview but provides no writable expression text input and no parser; the typed AST remains the sole canonical checksum-bound form (DEC-022).

Table-backed nodes (interpolate / lookup) are authored through a structured table sub-editor (TP-C2-TABLENODE-001): table id, argument/result dimension and unit refs, the {argument, result} rows, plus the recursive argument expression.
Monotonicity and out-of-range remain evaluator-enforced diagnostics surfaced as authoring guidance, never silently clamped in the composer.

Expression literal/table unit refs use the reviewed DEC-018 catalog when the desktop backend exposes it; browser preview keeps manual unit text and stored out-of-catalog units remain visible and selectable (TP-UNITS-B2-RULEEXPRUNITS-001).

Any unrecognized node tag and the refusal markers (unsupported_form / unsafe_host_access) are rendered read-only and preserved verbatim; the composer never silently drops or rewrites a subtree it does not edit.

EDITABLE_NODE_TYPES is the full frozen grammar v1.0.0 set: literal, variable_ref, unary, binary, compare, logical, select, aggregate, interpolate, lookup; refusal markers and unrecognized tags are excluded.
UNARY_OPERATORS are negate, abs, not.
BINARY_OPERATORS are add, subtract, multiply, divide.
COMPARE_OPERATORS are less_than, less_than_or_equal, greater_than, greater_than_or_equal, equal, not_equal.
LOGICAL_OPERATORS are and, or.
AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS are min, max.
LOOKUP_MODES are exact, step.

The frontend hash seam is the wasm build of the Rust engine's canonical_json / sha256_hex; the wasm lane of the canonical-hash parity corpus is asserted here against the same case files the native engine uses.
The wasm hash-parity corpus is loaded from fixtures/canonical_hash/cases.json, the shared case file blessed by the native Rust engine.
The canonical-hash parity corpus enforces a coverage floor of at least 12 cases.

Each parity case must have non-TBD expectations (blessed via CANONICAL_HASH_BLESS=1 cargo test) and the wasm engine's canonicalJsonString and canonicalSha256Hex must match the native expected_canonical and expected_sha256.
On malformed JSON the wasm engine throws the named diagnostic WASM-ENGINE-INPUT-JSON-INVALID instead of hashing it.

Engine canonicalization makes JSON key order irrelevant while content remains significant: reordered-key objects canonicalize identically (e.g. to '{"a":"x","b":[1,2,{"c":3,"d":4}]}'), and null/string scalars canonicalize to 'null'/'"text"'.
computeModelHash is stable under key reordering and sensitive to value change, yielding value sha256:<64-hex>, canonicalization rfc8785_jcs, and hash_status computed_local_preview.
computeModelHash equals the engine hash of the same payload (sha256:<direct hex>), proving there is no second hash implementation.

computePackageHash is deterministic and content-sensitive, exposes payload_excludes (default validation_report_package_hash_fields), and the carrier-exclusion label variant yields the same hash value.
canonicalJsonString drops undefined-valued keys before hashing, matching JSON.stringify semantics.

Frontend hashing routes through the wasm build of the Rust engine's canonical_json / sha256_hex via the loadWasmEngine seam; the prior TypeScript canonicalization is deleted with no fallback (absent wasm fails loudly with WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT).
asJsonText serializes a value via JSON.stringify, coercing undefined to null, so undefined-valued keys are dropped before hashing.
canonicalJsonString awaits the wasm engine and returns engine.canonicalJsonString of the value's JSON text.
canonicalSha256Hex awaits the wasm engine and returns engine.canonicalSha256Hex of the value's JSON text.

computeModelHash returns ModelHashEvidence with algorithm sha256, canonicalization rfc8785_jcs, payload_scope model_payload, payload_ref of the project id, value sha256:<hex>, and hash_status computed_local_preview.

computeProjectEnvelopeHash covers the persisted payload only, excluding the volatile storage summary and the envelope-hash carrier field (payload_excludes storage_summary_and_envelope_hash_carrier_fields) so the hash can be recomputed from a restored envelope.
computePackageHash returns PackageHashEvidence with payload_scope package_review_payload and a configurable payload_excludes defaulting to validation_report_package_hash_fields.
