LibraryImportFinding carries code, severity (blocking/quarantine/review_required), path, message, and remediation, where severity is the PRD §13.5 blocking-vs-advisory axis.
LibraryImportOutcome is one of QUARANTINE, REJECTED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY, or ACCEPTED_PUBLIC.
LibraryImportValidation envelope carries document_kind, outcome, library_kind, intended_visibility, accepted, has_blocking_findings, findings, diagnostics, and professional_boundary_notice.
isTauriRuntime detects the desktop runtime by checking window for __TAURI_INTERNALS__.
validateLibraryImport returns the unavailable route when not in the Tauri runtime; otherwise it invokes validate_library_import and returns a tauri_backend route.

partitionLibraryImportFindings partitions findings once at the seam: blocking/quarantine become blocking (cannot be accepted as-is) and review_required becomes advisory (human review before acceptance).

Imported private libraries persist in the local SQLite store only via the desktop backend; the store is private-by-default and never transmitted or committed, and save only persists an accepted import (blocked/quarantined returns stored:false with findings).
saveLocalLibrary invokes save_local_library with {projectId, libraryKind, document} and returns a tauri_backend save route, else the unavailable route in browser preview.
openLocalLibrary invokes open_local_library with {projectId, libraryKind, libraryId} returning the envelope or null.
listLocalLibraries invokes list_local_libraries with {projectId} returning the index entries.
deleteLocalLibrary invokes delete_local_library with {projectId, libraryKind, libraryId} returning the delete receipt.

TEMPLATE_PROVENANCE defines the invented private-draft provenance: source_name 'Invented local draft', redistribution_status private_only, review_status accepted, and a non-engineering contributor certification not for project reliance.

buildInventedLibraryImportTemplate produces a clean private-classified starting library document (schema_version 0.1.0, privacy_class private_user_data, template provenance, empty records) that validates to PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY for the user to edit.

LIBRARY_RECORD_SLOT_SHAPE per-kind dispatch must mirror the desktop resolver (extract_library_slot_value / find_library_slot_value): which member holds the records, which field is the record id, and which (slot_array, slot_id_field) pairs hold the value slots, scanned in order.
LibraryReferenceResolution is one of resolves, record_missing, slot_missing, or library_missing, where library_missing is decided by the panel (store list / null open) not by these helpers.

indexLibraryRecordsSlots is a pure function extracting record ids and per-record de-duplicated first-seen-order value-slot ids from a stored library document for a kind, mirroring the desktop resolver and never inventing missing-id or non-object entries.
classifyLibraryReference purely classifies an authored (recordId, slotId) against indexed records as record_missing, slot_missing, or resolves; library presence is decided upstream.

The cross-engine operation contract corpus runner reads the same case files as the Rust runner (contract_corpus.rs) from fixtures/model_operations/contract_corpus/ and executes each through the browser-mode adapter lane and the wasm engine directly.

Cross-engine comparison rules: exact equality on semantic fields; diagnostics compared order-insensitively as code/severity/blocking/affected_refs; engine-identity fields excluded only via the documented allowlist (application_route, diagnostics id/source/message/remediation).

Since H5 the engine canonicalization is RFC 8785 (JCS), so backend_model_hash and applied_model_backend_hash values are full byte-equality comparisons in every lane (JS transport 200.0->200 no longer shifts canonical bytes).

Applied model documents are compared both by parsed-JSON deep equality and by the engine's own canonical hash through the wasm exports; the retired ECMA harness renderer twins are superseded because engine rendering is transport-invariant.
All corpus data is invented (PUBLIC_DOMAIN_OR_ORIGINAL) with no protected standards content and no compliance/certification/approval claims.

REQUIRED_ACCEPTED_KINDS enumerates the operation kinds the corpus must cover with an accepted apply (set_field, update_load, create/delete node, connect/delete pipe_run, create section/material/support/load_case/primitive_load/combination/combination_term, and their deletes).

REQUIRED_BLOCK_CODES enumerates the blocking diagnostic codes the corpus must produce (e.g. OP-TARGET-ALREADY-EXISTS, OP-TARGET-NOT-FOUND, OP-UNIT-MISMATCH-CONVERSION-UNAVAILABLE, OP-STALE-BEFORE-VALUE, OP-NODE-DELETE-REFERENCED, OP-PIPE-DELETE-REFERENCED).
loadCases reads, filters to .json files, sorts, and parses every contract-corpus case file, asserting at least one exists.

semanticOutcome projects an engine OperationOutcome onto the cross-engine semantic comparison surface (mirrored exactly by semantic_outcome in the Rust runner), sorting diagnostics by a stable code/refs/severity key.

In the compared model_basis, backend_canonicalization label has been compared since TP-H1-HASHUNIFY-001 and backend_model_hash value joined the compared surface at H5 once RFC 8785 rendering made input-text hashes transport-invariant.

corpusCanonicalHash returns sha256:<engine canonicalSha256Hex of JSON.stringify(value)>, a single transport-invariant formula replacing the retired TS ECMA harness renderer for blessed-value comparison in every lane.
isDynamicPrimitiveMagnitudePath matches field paths of form primitive_loads.<n>.magnitude.value.
isDynamicTermFactorPath matches field paths of form terms.<n>.factor.

The corpus coverage test asserts every required accepted operation kind, every required blocking code, and both accepted and blocked instances of the dynamic field paths primitive_loads.N.magnitude.value and terms.N.factor are present.

Each adapter-lane case applies or validates the intent through operationService, asserts the input model is never mutated, asserts semanticOutcome equals the blessed outcome, and checks applied_model deep-equality plus byte-equal canonical hash (H5 full byte-equality).

The wasm engine lane runs the same 44 case files through the wasm32 build loaded exactly as browser mode loads it, proving native↔wasm parity; an absent wasm artifact fails loudly with WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT and npm run build:wasm, never skipping silently.
The wasm engine reports the honest local_wasm_engine application route.

On malformed input the wasm engine returns the structured input-error envelope (document_kind openpipestress.desktop.wasm_engine_input_error, code WASM-ENGINE-INPUT-JSON-INVALID, severity blocking) instead of trapping.

The thin-adapter tests cover routing, wasm input-error envelope handling, and engine-status reporting only; operation semantics live in core/model_operations/operation_applier and are proven by the cross-engine contract corpus.
acceptedApplyCase selects a corpus case in apply mode whose expected validation.application_status is applied_to_session_model.

In browser mode applyModelOperation routes through the wasm engine with route local_wasm_engine, sets validation.application_status applied_to_session_model, returns the expected applied_model, and never mutates the input model.
In browser mode validateModelOperation routes through the wasm engine, mode validate_only, with no applied model.
When a Tauri backend is present, apply/validate route verbatim to apply_model_operation and validate_model_operation with {model, intent, claimedModelHash}.
The adapter surfaces the wasm input-error envelope as an explicit thrown error (never a silent outcome) and passes other document kinds through.
Browser-mode operation engine status reports local_wasm_engine loading initially then ready after warmup.
With a Tauri backend present, the operation engine status reports route tauri_backend_apply as immediately ready.

operationService is a thin routing adapter for the editor-operation seam (DEC-020/ADR-0001): one engine, core/model_operations/operation_applier, answering as native via Tauri commands or the same crate as a wasm32 module; it contains routing and honest engine-status reporting only, never validation/diff/apply semantics.
outcomeFromWasmEngineJson parses a wasm-engine JSON return and, if it is the input-error envelope, throws an explicit error (the operation did not run); otherwise it returns the OperationOutcome.
runWasmOperation loads the wasm engine and runs applyOperationJson or validateOperationJson with stringified model, intent, and modelHash, returning the parsed outcome.
validateModelOperation invokes the validate_model_operation Tauri command when available, else runs the wasm engine in validate_only mode.
applyModelOperation invokes the apply_model_operation Tauri command when available, else runs the wasm engine in apply mode.
OperationEngineStatus reports which route answers operations and whether it is ready: tauri_backend_apply ready, local_wasm_engine loading/ready, or local_wasm_engine unavailable with a detail.
initialOperationEngineStatus reports tauri_backend_apply ready when a backend is present, otherwise local_wasm_engine loading.
warmupOperationEngine returns local_wasm_engine ready after loading the wasm engine, or unavailable with the error detail if loading fails (no fallback engine).
runPreviewMechanics returns the bundled solved fixture (project:invented-loop-01, MECHANICS_SOLVED, non-empty results) when no model payload is supplied.
runPreviewMechanics keeps the bundled solved fixture for the unchanged bundled model.

For an edited model in browser mode, runPreviewMechanics blocks fixture reuse: status MODEL_INCOMPLETE, empty results, and one blocking diagnostic BROWSER_SOLVE_BACKEND_REQUIRED_FOR_EDITED_MODEL, without mutating the original model.
appliedRuleCheckStatus uses a recognized rule-check aggregate over the solve rule_check (e.g. USER_RULE_FAILED, USER_RULE_CHECKED supersede RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE).
appliedRuleCheckStatus falls back to the solve rule_check for an absent, empty, or unrecognized aggregate, never coercing a non-rule-check status into a pass.
buildAnalysisRunPreview defaults analysis_status to the solve envelope rule_check when no aggregate is supplied.
A recognized rule-check aggregate drives analysis_status and the analysis_run_record hash while leaving the raw solve result_envelope hash byte-stable (the raw solve envelope is never mutated).
An unrecognized rule-check aggregate is ignored, reproducing the no-aggregate envelope exactly with no false pass.
invokeOrFixture invokes a Tauri command when the runtime is present and falls back to a bundled fixture in browser mode or on invoke failure.
loadPreviewModel returns the invented preview model fixture (or the Tauri load_preview_model command).
runPreviewMechanics invokes run_preview_mechanics with the model or falls back to the browser preview mechanics path.
SolveJobStartReceipt is either a backend_job (job_id, backend_cancellation_token, state, cancellation_scope) or browser_fixture_no_backend_job.
BackendSolveJobStatus carries job_id, state (queued/running/completed/cancelled/failed), cancellation_requested/status/scope, result, and error_message.
startPreviewMechanicsJob returns browser_fixture_no_backend_job in browser mode, else starts the backend job via start_preview_mechanics_job (falling back on failure).
pollPreviewMechanicsJob invokes poll_preview_mechanics_job with {jobId}.
cancelPreviewMechanicsJob invokes cancel_preview_mechanics_job with {jobId, cancellationToken}.
RULE_CHECK_RUN_STATUSES is the frozen set of GUI rule-check run statuses (RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED); anything outside it is not silently coerced.

appliedRuleCheckStatus returns a recognized rule-check aggregate (the worst-of over the checks run against this solve) over the solve envelope rule_check, else falls back to the solve rule_check, never a false pass.

buildAnalysisRunPreview builds the app-held analysis-run envelope (DEL-14-02) for a solved result; a supplied rule-check aggregate composes into analysis_status and the analysis_run_record hash, while the embedded result_envelope hash still binds the unmutated raw solve.

buildPreviewComparison builds a single-run load-basis comparison (DEL-14-04) by matching left load-case result rows to right combination rows via stable result ids and source_result_refs, computing raw and absolute deltas classified as not_tolerance_checked.
Comparison deltas are classified not_tolerance_checked with classification_basis governed_tolerance_profile_TBD_no_default_engineering_threshold (no default engineering threshold applied).
loadBasisRefsFor collects de-duplicated load-basis ObjectRefs (Combination or LoadCase) from a result's rows.
comparisonDiagnostics emits info COMPARISON_REFERENCE_ROWS_UNMATCHED and warning COMPARISON_TARGET_ROWS_UNMATCHED diagnostics for unmatched left/right rows, capped at 12 affected refs.
resultFamily classifies a result into displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, ratio, or TBD by inspecting its kind and id.
canonicalJson serializes a value with recursively sorted object keys (sortJson) for stable hashing.
sha256 hashes a payload via crypto.subtle when available, otherwise returns an explicit sha256-unavailable-<hex> marker rather than a real hash.

buildProposalFromMechanics generates a review-only agent proposal from the current preview mechanics context (selecting a force result or primary diagnostic as the target) whose narrative does not mutate accepted model state.

evaluateModelDocumentLocal evaluates a current document as status current with the in-document version authority, framework application_service_separate_db_and_product_schema, and no applied migrations.
A 0.1.0 document migrates in memory through the mirrored DEC-033 no-op chain entry model-doc-0.1.0-to-0.2.0-additive-combination-shape-noop to the supported version.

createLocalProject accepts a 0.1.0 document with migrated evidence while keeping stored snapshot bytes unchanged (no migration ledger in browser preview), and openLocalProject preserves the migrated status.
evaluateModelDocumentLocal refuses newer-than-supported (no down-migration), invalid non-semver (unsupported_schema), and older-with-no-path (unsupported_schema) versions without coercion.
create/save/open round-trips at the supported version yield status current, an empty migration ledger, and unit round-trip status unit_metadata_preserved_in_local_project_envelope.

buildBlankLocalModelDocument builds a blank authoring document at the supported version with empty entity arrays, MODEL_INCOMPLETE/RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE status, a not_committed_to_repository private-data policy, and a blocking BLANK_PROJECT_AUTHORING_TARGET diagnostic.
createLocalProject and saveLocalProject refuse to persist documents with refused schema versions (newer_than_supported, unsupported_schema).

DEC-033 (2026-06-12): SUPPORTED_MODEL_SCHEMA_VERSION is 0.2.0, adding the optional combination shape fields from TP-APP-R2-COMBEXPR-001; the browser preview mirrors apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/model_document_migration.rs.

MODEL_DOCUMENT_MIGRATIONS_LOCAL is the browser-preview mirror of the backend transform chain; the 0.1.0->0.2.0 step is a documented no-op (the 0.2.0 shape only adds optional combination members) that stamps the version.
parseSemver parses a strict major.minor.patch string into a numeric tuple or null.
evaluateModelDocumentLocal returns the migration status from migrateModelDocumentLocal (browser-preview mirror of the backend DEC-019 evaluation).

migrateModelDocumentLocal classifies a model document as current, migrated (walking the mirrored transform chain in memory), newer_than_supported, or unsupported_schema, refusing invalid/newer documents without coercion.

Older-than-supported documents walk the mirrored transform chain in memory, accumulating applied_migration_ids and stamping each step's target version until reaching the supported version, with stored bytes unchanged until save.
requireEditableModelDocument throws if a document's migration status is not current or migrated, surfacing status, source/target schema versions, and detail.
localOnlyCapability describes the browser memory preview storage capability: bundled, no fts5, no network/daemon/telemetry, browser-session memory fallback path, and no SQLite migration ledger.

The envelope builder mirrors DEC-019/DEC-033: older documents migrate in memory and newer/unsupported are refused, but the browser preview has no migration ledger so it stores the document bytes as given and keeps the migration as in-memory evidence (no silent destructive rewrite).
cloneEnvelope deep-clones a LocalProjectEnvelope (summary, model, intents, proposal, review target, mechanics/analysis/hashes, migration status, migration ledger).

unitRoundTripSummary collects unit metadata refs across project units, materials, sections, pipe segments, and load-case primitive loads, reporting unit_metadata_preserved when all present or unit_metadata_missing_review_required otherwise, with a sorted signature.
collectQuantityUnit records a quantity's unit ref when present, or marks it missing when the value has a quantity value but no unit.
getLocalStorageCapability returns localOnlyCapability in browser mode, else invokes get_local_storage_capability.

buildBlankLocalModelDocument builds a timestamped blank local model document at the supported schema version with explicit units, empty entity arrays, MODEL_INCOMPLETE status, and a blocking authoring-target diagnostic, inserting no fixture entities or engineering defaults.
createLocalProject stores a browser-preview snapshot via envelope in browser mode (recording timestamps), else invokes create_local_project with the model and persisted artifacts.
openLocalProject returns a cloned browser-preview snapshot (re-validating editability, optionally filtered by project id) in browser mode, else invokes open_local_project.
listLocalProjects returns the single browser-preview snapshot index entry in browser mode, else invokes list_local_projects.
saveLocalProject overwrites the browser-preview snapshot in browser mode, else invokes save_local_project with a request carrying the model and persisted artifacts.

DEC-021 (A7): the hash-bound report renderer is a Rust crate reached through the desktop Tauri command seam; the browser preview exposes no rendering seam and there is no fallback renderer (browser mode reports an explicit unavailable route).
RenderedReportOutcome carries html, sha256_hex, export_blocked, blocking_reasons, report/section validation diagnostics, pre/post-render findings, and derived_print_html.

renderCalculationReport returns an unavailable_browser_preview route with REPORT-RENDERER-DESKTOP-ONLY when not in the Tauri runtime, else invokes render_calculation_report and returns the tauri_renderer outcome.

Phase C4 GUI slice (TP-C4-CHECKGUI-001) tests: jsdom has no Tauri runtime, so the run route pins the honest browser-preview seam (explicit desktop-only diagnostic, no synthesized fallback) by default; backend-path tests opt in by setting __TAURI_INTERNALS__ and mocking invoke.
deriveRuleCheckBindingPlan partitions a rule pack's required inputs by source kind (solver_result, user_supplied_rule_value, private_library_value) and collects value slots.
deriveRuleCheckBindingPlan falls back to TBD dimension and TBD unit_ref, and uses the input id as the name, when quantity metadata is absent.

classifySolverResultReference returns 'resolves' when the authored result id is present, 'result_missing' when result rows exist but the id is absent, and 'no_result_rows' when no solved result rows are available.
runRuleChecks reports the desktop-only unavailable route ('unavailable_browser_preview') in browser preview with no Tauri runtime, and does not call invoke.
runRuleChecks omits empty binding arrays when invoking run_rule_checks so the backend treats absent bindings as unsupplied (never a silent pass).
runRuleChecks forwards non-empty solver-result and supplied-value bindings and prefers a solved envelope over the model so the backend does not re-solve.
loadDemoRuleCheckPack loads the bundled invented demonstration pack (rule_pack_id 'invented_demo_rule_pack', grammar_version 1.0.0) with a runnable binding-plan shape.

Rule-check runner seam (Phase C4, TP-C4-CHECKGUI-001): running a rule pack's checks against a solved model routes through the desktop (Tauri) run_rule_checks command backed by core/rules/rule_check_runner; browser preview has no backend and reports an explicit unavailable route instead of synthesizing a fallback evaluator.

The rule-check runner emits ONLY the three automatic rule-check statuses and makes no professional, certification, sealing, authentication, approval, or code-compliance claim (PRD §12.5, §22.4; DEC-022 grammar v1.0.0).

RuleCheckStatus is one of three automatic statuses: RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED. The wider vocabulary (MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED) and the external HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT record are not producible here.
SolverResultSelector binding is caller-supplied because the schema carries no selector tying a solver_result required input to a solved result row, per the rule_check_runner contract.

runRuleChecks prefers an already-solved envelope (so the backend does not re-solve) and falls back to the model so the backend solves it; projectId scopes the private-library lookup for private_library_value inputs (resolved backend-side from the local store).

loadDemoRuleCheckPack returns the invented non-engineering demonstration rule pack (DEL-06-05), byte-parallel to backend fixture examples/rule_packs/invented_demo.yaml; it is NOT an engineering design basis and is not suitable for professional reliance.
LibraryValueRef references a value in a saved private library record, resolved backend-side from the local store at run time and never embedded in the rule pack (IP boundary).
SolverResultRef references a row in the current solved result envelope; authored references are canonical and the run-panel selector is used only for older packs without this member.

RuleCheckBindingPlan: solverInputs bind to a solved result row; valueInputs and valueSlots take a user-entered value plus unit (dimension from the pack); private-library inputs are surfaced separately and treated as unsupplied (never a silent pass).

deriveRuleCheckBindingPlan iterates required_inputs, routing solver_result kinds to solverInputs, private_library_value kinds to libraryInputs, and all other kinds to valueInputs, then collects value_slots.
SolverResultReferenceResolution is one of: 'resolves', 'result_missing', 'no_result_rows', classified by classifySolverResultReference against the solved result rows.

Rule-pack backend seam (Phase C2, TP-MAC-147): validation, checksum computation, and local persistence route through the desktop (Tauri) commands backed by core/rules; browser preview keeps drafts in memory only and reports an explicit unavailable route instead of synthesizing a TypeScript fallback engine.
Private rule packs persist in the local SQLite store only and are never transmitted or committed (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD §17.3).

validateRulePack invokes the Tauri validate_rule_pack command with the document and a publicExportRequested flag, returning a RulePackDocumentValidation; in browser preview it returns the unavailable route.
computeRulePackChecksum invokes the Tauri compute_rule_pack_document_checksum command and returns a RulePackComputedChecksum.

saveLocalRulePack invokes the Tauri save_local_rule_pack command with projectId and document, returning a LocalRulePackEnvelope; openLocalRulePack, listLocalRulePacks, and deleteLocalRulePack route through their respective Tauri commands.

draftPlaceholderProvenance returns placeholder provenance for draft authoring surfaces; every field is invented non-engineering wording or TBD, never a copied source, standards citation, or code value (PRD §12.4, IP boundary).

buildDraftRulePackDocument builds a 'New draft rule pack' that is private by default (PRD §12.4); every placeholder is TBD or invented non-engineering wording and the editor never prefills code equations or standards values (PRD §14.5).

A draft rule pack's formula declaration uses declaration_form 'declarative_ast' in the frozen open_pipe_stress_declared_expression grammar (DEC-022 v1.0.0) with arbitrary_code_execution_allowed false and protected_content_policy private_user_owned_reference_only.

A draft rule pack's professional_boundary asserts the software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim; human review is required and project reliance requires separate human review bound to current model, report, and rule-pack hashes.
stampChecksumIntoDocument returns a new document with the computed checksum stamped in (verification_status 'verified', hash_basis 'Canonical JSON/JCS-compatible'), leaving other members untouched.
unitCatalogService reports an explicit browser-preview unavailable route (diagnostic UNIT-CATALOG-DESKTOP-ONLY) instead of synthesizing units when no Tauri runtime is present.

loadUnitCatalog loads the reviewed DEC-018 unit catalog via the Tauri get_unit_catalog command in desktop mode, with storage_convention 'entered_units_preserved' and a boundary asserting no protected content and no professional-approval claim.

describeUnitBasis maps model-unit fields against the reviewed catalog: a canonical match yields a 'DEC-018 canonical' label, a catalog miss yields 'catalog mismatch', and the browser-preview route yields 'model metadata' without inventing browser units.

A UnitCatalogEntry transform_kind is one of identity, multiplicative, or affine; provenance is one of si_canonical, exact_public_definition, conventional_public_constant, or project_governed_decision.

UnitCatalog declares calculation_basis 'si_canonical' and storage_convention 'entered_units_preserved' with a boundary describing protected-content, private-data, professional-approval, and code-compliance exclusions.

loadUnitCatalog returns an unavailable_browser_preview route with UNIT-CATALOG-DESKTOP-ONLY diagnostic when no Tauri runtime is present, otherwise invokes get_unit_catalog; browser preview does not synthesize a fallback catalog.
acceptedUnits filters a unit catalog to entries whose review_status is 'accepted'.
unitCatalogEntryForSymbol matches a catalog entry by normalized symbol and dimension, preferring an accepted entry over any matching entry.
describeUnitBasis produces a UnitBasisDisplay distinguishing catalog_loading, browser_preview_model_metadata, dec018_catalog_accepted, dec018_catalog_unreviewed, and dec018_catalog_miss sources.

dimensionMatches treats requested dimensions as equivalent to catalog dimensions: displacement↔length, stress↔pressure, rotation↔angle, slope↔dimensionless, linear_stiffness↔force_per_length, volume_per_length↔area.
usePackageHash is a React hook keyed on stable JSON text of the packet; canonicalization and hashing happen inside the wasm engine (H1 / F-5a) and the frontend no longer canonicalizes anything.

withCanonicalPackageHash stamps the computed package hash into a packet's manifest and validation_report, marking status computed_local_preview_sha256 when present or TBD_browser_preview_does_not_emit_canonical_package_hash when absent.
loadWasmEngine loads the wasm32 build of core/model_operations/operation_applier — the sole browser-mode operation engine per DEC-020 / ADR-0001.

The wasm glue and artifact are produced by 'npm run build:wasm' into public/wasm-engine/ and are not committed; an absent artifact is an explicit named failure (WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT) with the build command, never a silent fallback because no other engine exists.

WasmOperationEngine exposes validateOperationJson, applyOperationJson, and the H1/F-5a hash seam (canonicalJsonString, canonicalSha256Hex) so the frontend never re-implements canonicalization or hashing; both hash functions throw on invalid JSON (WASM-ENGINE-INPUT-JSON-INVALID).

The browser wasm import must be a fully-qualified URL resolved against location.href, not a root-absolute path, because Vite's dev transform refuses to serve publicDir files with the ?import query (HTTP 500); the helper skips URLs carrying a protocol.

Under Node/Vitest, locateAssetsUnderNode probes deterministic candidate paths for the generated wasm assets and fails loudly listing every probed path; this probes one artifact set and is not an engine fallback.
loadWasmEngine is a lazy singleton: the first caller triggers instantiation and failures are not cached, so a later call after 'npm run build:wasm' succeeds.

The OpenPipeStress desktop shell stylesheet (TP-APP-R2-UXSHELL-001) is structured as base+chrome, workspace layout (modeling-workspace and workspace-dock), panel primitives, and feature panels in source order.

Stylesheet layout invariants: every scroll container is a .workspace-pane, the .workspace-dock-body, or an explicitly bounded panel region; panels grow with content instead of clipping, and form rows wrap rather than overflow.
The persistent spatial core (PRD 14.1) is a three-column grid: model tree (280px) | viewport (flexible) | inspector (380px), via the .modeling-workspace rule.
Inactive workspace-dock sections stay mounted so state survives navigation but are fully hidden (display:none), including from the accessibility tree.

The Vitest setup pre-warms the wasm operation engine (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) so jsdom suites that exercise the edit loop start with the engine ready; an absent artifact fails the suite loudly with the build command (WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT → 'npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop'), with no fallback engine.
PreviewModel.Vec3 is a 3D vector type with numeric x, y, z fields.
PreviewModel is the desktop preview document model carrying schema_version, document_kind, data_boundary, project, analysis_status, model entities, and diagnostics.
PreviewModel.project carries id, name, description, and a units map.
PreviewModel.analysis_status reports mechanics, rule_check, and professional_acceptance status strings.
PreviewModel.materials entries carry id, label, elastic_modulus, shear_modulus, optional thermal_expansion_coefficient (each a value/unit pair), and provenance.
PreviewModel.sections entries carry id, name, section_type (pipe|rigid|custom|TBD|string), a properties map of value/unit pairs (e.g. outside_diameter, wall_thickness), and provenance.
PreviewModel.nodes entries carry id, label, position (Vec3), and provenance.
PreviewModel.pipe_segments entries carry id, label, from, to, section value/unit map, material, optional y_reference (Vec3), and provenance.
PreviewModel.supports entries carry id, label, node, a restraints string list, and provenance.
PreviewModel.components entries carry id, label, kind, node, and provenance.
PreviewModel.load_cases entries carry id, label, kind, status, provenance, and optional primitive_loads.
PreviewModel.combinations entries carry id, label, a basis string, terms (load_case + factor), optional minuend_id/subtrahend_id/operand_ids/mode, and provenance.
Combination.basis is a closed basis set mirroring core load_case_algebra vocabulary: mechanics, result_state_subtraction, or range_envelope.
Diagnostic carries optional id, a code, a severity (info|warning|error|blocking), a message, optional source, and optional affected_refs.
KnowledgeRecord carries id, kind, title, summary, affected_refs, provenance, and status.
DesignKnowledge carries schema_version, document_kind, knowledge_set_id, model_ref, a records list, and diagnostics.
MechanicsResult carries schema_version, document_kind, run_id, model_ref, status, summary, a results list, and diagnostics.
MechanicsResult.summary may include max_displacement and max_open_formula_stress, each a value/unit with location_ref and result_ref or null.

MechanicsResult.results entries carry id, kind, value, unit, entity_ref, optional basis_ref, optional source_result_refs, and optional metadata (component, coordinate_system, location, basis, sign_convention).
ResultBasisRef carries a ref_type (load_case|combination|string) and a ref_id.
SelectedReviewTarget is a discriminated union over target_type result, diagnostic, or model_entity, each with an id.

ResultInterpretation describes a result's family, entity_ref, value_label, component, coordinate_system, location, recovery_basis, sign_convention, source_result_refs, linked diagnostics and knowledge, source_run metadata, optional endpoint_pair, and professional_boundary.
ResultInterpretation.source_run records run_id, model_ref, audit_ref, result_hash_count, and envelope_hash_available.
ResultInterpretation.endpoint_pair pairs two endpoint values sharing entity_ref/component/coordinate_system/recovery_basis, each with result_id, location, value_label, and sign_convention.
DiagnosticInterpretation describes a diagnostic's code, severity, source, message, affected_refs, linked_results, linked_knowledge, review_explanation, and professional_boundary.
MechanicsGap carries id, capability, status (implemented|deferred|not_implemented|requires_private_inputs), and a review_note.
ObjectRef carries an object_type and a ref string.
AnalysisRunEnvelope is the DEL-14-02 / PKG-14 analysis run record carrying schema_version, scope_item, objectives, run_contract_status, and an analysis_run block.

AnalysisRunEnvelope.analysis_run carries run_id, run_name, run_kind, model_state_ref, load_basis_refs, result_refs, hashes, analysis_status, reproducibility, immutability_policy, and professional_boundary.
analysis_run.result_refs entries carry result_ref, result_family, hash_refs, and privacy_classification.
analysis_run hash_refs use algorithm sha256 with a canonicalization, payload_ref, payload_scope, and value.
analysis_run.reproducibility carries input_manifest_refs, determinism_notes, and unresolved_tbd.
analysis_run.immutability_policy declares run_record_is_read_only, mutation_policy, new_run_required_for_change, and hash_invalidates_external_acceptance.
SolveJobEvent carries event_id, a state (not_started|queued|running|cancelling|cancelled|completed|failed), message, result_available, diagnostic_count, result_row_count, and analysis_status.
SolveJobAuditState audits a solve job's job_id, state, progress_basis, backend seam, cancellation status, backend job id/token, events, and error_message.
SolveJobAuditState declares percentages_synthesized false and backend_percent_stream_available false (no synthesized progress percentages).
SolveJobBackendSeam is one of tauri_backend_job, browser_fixture_no_backend_job, no_job_started, or restored_persisted_run_no_new_solve.
PreviewComparison (document_kind openpipestress.technical_preview.comparison, DEL-14-04 / PKG-14) is a single_run_load_basis_review comparing a left and right participant.
PreviewComparison.summary reports comparable_result_pairs, unmatched left/right results, mapping_basis, tolerance_status not_tolerance_checked, and tolerance_profile_ref TBD.
ComparisonParticipant carries label, basis_ref, model_state_ref, analysis_run_ref, and result_count.

ComparisonDelta carries mapping_id, left/right result ids, entity_ref, result_family, component, location, unit, left/right values, raw_delta, absolute_delta, classification not_tolerance_checked, and classification_basis.
AgentProposal carries schema_version, document_kind, proposal_id, prompt, an operation block, rationale, assumptions, validation, audit_boundary, and professional_boundary.
AgentProposal.operation carries operation_id, operation_kind, operation_status, affected_entity_ids, and changes (change_id, change_kind, target_ref, before, after).
AgentProposal.audit_boundary declares requires_user_acceptance, mutates_accepted_model_state, and acceptance_recorded_as_review_only.
EditorOperationObjectType enumerates Material, Section, Node, Element, Component, Support, Load, and Combination.
EditorOperationSource carries source_ref, source_channel (e.g. local_desktop_preview), and source_role (e.g. gui_editor, viewport_editor).

EditorOperationIntent represents a proposed user editor operation with optional queue_id, operation_id, operation_kind (create|connect|delete|insert|modify), operation_status proposed, author_type user, optional source, target, change, validation, audit_boundary, professional_boundary, and rationale.

EditorOperationIntent.change.change_kind enumerates the structured edit kinds: set_field, update_load, update_support, create/delete node, connect/delete pipe_run, create section/material/support/load_case, delete load_case, create/delete primitive_load, create/delete combination, create/delete combination_term, delete support, and insert_component_symbol.
EditorOperationIntent.validation initializes schema/constraint/unit validation as not_run, diff_preview_status not_generated, and application_status not_applied.
EditorOperationIntent.audit_boundary declares mutation_route structured_operations_only, direct_model_mutation_allowed false, requires_user_acceptance true, and mutates_accepted_model_state false.
EditorOperationIntent.professional_boundary asserts human_review_required true and that software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.
OperationOutcomeDiagnostic carries id, code, severity (blocking|warning|info|string), message, remediation, affected_refs, and source.
OperationDiffPreviewRow carries entity_ref, object_type, field_path, before, after, unit, dimension, and change_kind.
OperationValidationStates carries schema, reference, unit, and before_state validation states plus diff_preview_status and application_status.
OperationModelBasisEvidence carries claimed_model_hash, claimed_hash_canonicalization, backend_model_hash, backend_canonicalization, and binding_status.
OperationAcceptanceRecord carries acceptance_basis, acceptance_is_professional_approval, and persistence_status.

OperationOutcome records an operation's mode (validate_only|apply), application_route (tauri_backend_apply|local_wasm_engine), identifiers, validation, diff_preview, diagnostics, model_basis, input_model_unchanged, applied_model, applied_model_backend_hash, acceptance, audit_boundary, and professional_boundary.

AppliedOperationReceipt records receipt_id, sequence, operation/change ids, target object_type and ref, field_path, before, after, application_route, applied_model_hash, acceptance, diagnostics, and professional_boundary.
EntityRef carries an id and a type drawn from project, material, section, node, pipe, support, component, load, combination, or diagnostic.

LocalStorageCapability describes the local store: engine (e.g. SQLite), bundled, fts5_available, network_required, daemon_required, telemetry_enabled, path/large_file policies, database_path, compile_options, migration_framework/status, schema versions, and migrations_applied_on_open.

LocalProjectSummary summarizes a local project's id/name, database_path, storage_mode, migration status/framework, schema versions, fts_indexed, copied_external_files, and counts/refs for editor intents, proposals, review targets, mechanics results, analysis runs, and model/envelope hashes, plus unit_round_trip status/signature.
LocalProjectIndexEntry carries project_id, project_name, storage_mode (local_sqlite|browser_memory_preview|string), created_at_unix, and updated_at_unix.
ModelHashEvidence records a model hash using algorithm sha256, canonicalization rfc8785_jcs, payload_scope model_payload, payload_ref, value, and hash_status computed_local_preview.

ModelHashIntegrityEvidence reports integrity_status (verified_match|mismatch_review_required|not_persisted|hash_recompute_unavailable), persisted and recomputed values, payload_ref, and verification_basis recomputed_on_open_from_restored_model.
ProjectEnvelopeHashEvidence records the project envelope hash (sha256, rfc8785_jcs) over payload_scope project_envelope_payload excluding storage_summary_and_envelope_hash_carrier_fields.
ProjectEnvelopeHashIntegrityEvidence reports envelope hash integrity_status, persisted/recomputed values, payload_ref, and verification_basis recomputed_on_open_from_restored_envelope_payload.
PackageHashEvidence records a package_review_payload hash (sha256, rfc8785_jcs) excluding validation-report/manifest package-hash carrier fields.

ModelDocumentMigrationStatus reports status (current|migrated|newer_than_supported|unsupported_schema|failed), source/target schema versions, migration_framework, db and product schema migration statuses, applied_migration_ids, persistence_state, and detail.

ModelMigrationLedgerRecord records a migration event with record_kind, recorded_at_unix, source/target schema versions, applied_migration_ids, migration_framework, pre/post migration model hashes, trigger, destructive_rewrite flag, and professional_boundary.

LocalProjectEnvelope aggregates summary, model, editor_intents, proposal, selected_review_target, mechanics_result, analysis_run, model_hash, project_envelope_hash, model_document_migration, and model_migration_ledger.

Build-time guard TP-APP-R2-WASMPKG-001: the wasm operation engine is the sole browser-mode engine (DEC-020 / ADR-0001), so a production bundle missing public/wasm-engine/ assets is broken by construction and must fail the build loudly.
The required wasm engine asset filenames are open_pipe_stress_operation_applier.js and open_pipe_stress_operation_applier_bg.wasm.
missingWasmEngineAssets(dir) returns the wasm engine asset filenames absent from dir/wasm-engine/.

wasmEngineGuardError raises a WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT error naming the missing assets and instructing to build with `npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop` and rebuild, since no fallback engine exists.
wasmEngineDistGuard is a build-only Vite plugin that checks public/wasm-engine/ at buildStart and dist/wasm-engine/ at closeBundle, throwing if assets are missing.
The Vite config registers the react() plugin and wasmEngineDistGuard plugin and sets clearScreen false.
The dev server runs on port 5173 with strictPort false.
manualChunks splits node_modules into vendor chunks: vendor-three (three), vendor-react (react/react-dom), vendor-icons (lucide-react), vendor-tauri (@tauri-apps), and a default vendor chunk.
The Vitest config uses the jsdom environment, globals, includes src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}, and the ./src/test/setup.ts setup file.
Vitest test and hook timeouts are raised to 30000ms because the full <App /> renders flake at the default 5s timeout under load; a genuine 30s+ render indicates a real defect.
